The blast creates earth pillars 3 tiles behind this target and knocks back enemies on those tiles by 1 tile. A maximum of 6 pillars can be present on the field.

skills.name: Rolling Boulder
skills.lite: Alsa deals damage to all enemies recently affected by control effects.
skills.full: Alsa senses the vibrations of leylines to locate all enemies recently affected by control effects, then drops boulders on them, dealing ATK 250% + PWR 25% damage.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Haste during battle.
skills.full: Increases Haste by 10 during battles, gaining an extra 6 Haste after entering the Combat Stance status.

skills.name: Don of Terra
skills.lite: Increases combat capabilities under the Combat Stance.
skills.full: Alsa increases the damage of Vigorous Slam by ATK 50% after dealing damage with the skill, stacking up to 2 times. She also increases the shield value of Swift Evasion by 5% of her max HP after casting it, stacking up to 2 times.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Rolling Boulder deals extra damage to enemies recently affected by multiple control effects.
skills.full: Rolling Boulder deals an extra ATK 180% damage to enemies recently affected by multiple control effects.

skills.name: Echo of Silence
skills.lite: Dunlingr sets the stage for the battle's order before a battle starts, ensuring everyone follows it for a period of time. Active. Dunlingr enforces the order again for an additional period of time.
skills.full: Dunlingr designates the Bell of Order as either Spellbind or Curelock before a battle starts, setting the stage for the battle's order. Spellbind: Unable to cast Ultimate. Curelock: Unable to recover HP for others. Active. Dunlingr summons the Bell of Order, declaring an order that all non-boss units on both sides must obey unconditionally for 6 + PWR 0.25s. Passive Dunlingr summons the Bell of Order when a battle starts and keeps it on the battlefield for 12 + PWR 0.5s. The Bell of Order deals ATK 200% + PWR 20% damage to all enemies each time it is summoned. After Dunlingr is defeated, the order's effect duration is reduced to 30% of the remaining time.

skills.name: Grand Resonance
skills.lite: Dunlingr deals damage to enemies in front of him and applies additional effects based on the specified order he has set.
skills.full: Dunlingr releases a shockwave covering the frontal area (3-tile wide and 3-tile long), dealing 4 hits of ATK 40% + PWR 5% damage each to enemies within. If the Bell of Order is set to Spellbind, Dunlingr reduces the enemies' ATK SPD by an extra 60 for 4s If the Bell of Order is set to Curelock, Dunlingr deals extra damage equal to 3% of the enemies' lost HP, up to 30% of his own ATK.

skills.name: Harmonic Soundwall
skills.lite: Dunlingr gains a shield whenever conditions of the specified order are met.
skills.full: If the Bell of Order is set to Spellbind, Dunlingr gains a shield that absorbs ATK 130% + PWR 20% damage whenever an enemy casts their Ultimate, lasting until the battle ends. If the Bell of Order is set to Curelock, Dunlingr gains a shield that absorbs ATK 130% + PWR 20% damage each time he loses 20% of his max HP, lasting until the battle ends.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Reduces damage taken during battle.
skills.full: Dunlingr reduces damage taken by 10% during the battle. While the order is in effect, he further reduces damage taken by an extra 5%.

skills.name: Clemency Chime
skills.lite: Dunlingr ensures the farthest ally is not affected by his order.
skills.full: Dunlingr protects the farthest non-summoned ally, ensuring they are not affected by his order until the ally is defeated.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Dunlingr increases ATK SPD or Life Drain for allies upon casting Echo of Silence.
skills.full: Upon casting Echo of Silence, Dunlingr grants all allies 50 ATK SPD for 6s if the order is set to e Spellbind, or provides them with 25 Life Drain for 6s if the order is set to Curelock.

skills.name: Deathmark Arrow
skills.lite: Bonnie deals damage to all enemies, with increased damage and a stun effect on those afflicted by Aging.
skills.full: Bonnie fires magic arrows, dealing ATK 180% + PWR 20% damage to each enemy twice. The magic arrrow deals 30% more damage to enemies afflicted by Aging and stuns them for 3 + PWR 0.25s.

skills.name: Decay's Reach
skills.lite: Bonnie casts the Aging magic on the rearmost enemy, reducing their Haste. Whenever any other allied hero deals magic damage to the enemy afflicted by Aging, the effect is further enhanced.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Bonnie casts the Aging magic on the rearmost enemy, dealing ATK 150% + PWR 10% damage and reducing their Haste by 30 until the battle ends. Bonnie prioritizes attacking this target afflicted by Aging. Whenever an allied hero deals magic damage to the enemy afflicted by aging, the effect is further enhanced, reducing their Haste by an extra 10. Each ally can only trigger the enhancement once, and the Aging magic can be enhanced up to 2 times. Once the Aging effect reaches its maximum stack, the afflicted enemy suffers a 30% + PWR 3% reduction in their ATK and takes 100% damage every 1s.

skills.name: Nightfall Shift
skills.lite: Bonnie transforms into a black mist and moves to a safe spot.
skills.full: Bonnie transforms into a black mist, moving to a safe spot within 4 tiles and firing 6 arrows, each daling ATK 35% + PWR 5% damage to an enemy. While in black mist form, Bonnie is .

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases ATK.
skills.full: Increases ATK by 12% during battle.

skills.name: Blight Surge
skills.lite: When Aging reaches its maximum stack or an Aged enemy is defeated, the effect spreads to an unafflicted enemy.
skills.full: When Aging reaches its maximum stack or an Aged enemy is defeated, the effect spreads to the nearest 1 unafflicted enemy, dealing ATK 260% damage to each.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: When Aging reaches its maximum stack on an enemy, they take more magic damage.
skills.full: When the Aging effect reaches its maximum stack on an enemy, their magic damage taken is increased by 10%, with an extra 20% increase for magic damage taken from Ultimates.

skills.name: Starlight Waltz
skills.lite: Elijah and Lailah greatly increase all allies' Haste and make allies linked through Stellar Bond unaffected.
skills.full: Passive. Elijah and Lailah fight separately in battle but share the same HP and Energy pool. Their max HP is increased by 50%. Active. Elijah and Lailah perform an inspiring duo dance, increasing all allies' Haste by 60 + PWR 4 for 7s. During the dance, allies linked through Stellar Bond become . The skill can be cast as long as Elijah is able to use Ultimate.

skills.name: Stellar Bond
skills.lite: Elijah and Lailah form a straight-line link, channeling blessings that recover allies' Energy and HP along the path.
skills.full: Elijah forms a Stellar Bond with Lailah when they align on the battlefield. Allied heroes placed in a between the twins are also linked by Stellar Bond. Stellar Bond grants a permanent ATK bonus to all linked allies, including Elijah and Lailah. If no other allies are linked, Elijah and Lailah gain an ATK increase of 25%. However, for each additional ally linked, this ATK bonus is reduced by 5% for everyone linked by the bond. Active. Elijah channels a golden glow through the Stellar Bond link to Lailah, restoring 30 + PWR 4 Energy for each ally along its path. Simultaneously, Lailah sends a green glow through the Stellar Bond link to Elijah, healing each ally along the path for an HP amount equal to ATK 100% + PWR 10%.

skills.name: Cosmic Protection
skills.lite: Elijah grants a shield to allies, while Lailah casts Stellar Pulse to deal damage and inflict blind on enemies surrounding her allies.
skills.full: Elijah grants Lailah and 1 ally a ATK 150% + PWR 15% shield that lasts for 4 + PWR 0.4s and makes Lailah while the shield is active. Lailah casts Stellar Pulse on the tiles occupied by Elijah and 1 ally adjacent to enemies, dealing ATK 110% + PWR 10% damage and inflicting for 4 + PWR 0.4s on enemies within 1 tile of the target tiles. Stellar Pulse also knocks back enemies surrounding Lailah by 1 tile.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Elijah and Lailah increase their own Haste and grant extra Haste to allies linked through Stellar Bond each time they cast Starlight Waltz.
skills.full: Elijah and Lailah increase their Haste by 9 in battle. Each time they cast Starlight Waltz, they permanently increase the Haste of all allies linked through Stellar Bond by 3, stacking up to 3 times.

skills.name: Starbound Harmony
skills.lite: When all linked allies belong to the same faction, Stellar Bond becomes stronger and is permanently enhanced after all linked allies use their Ultimate.
skills.full: When a battle starts, if the allies (excluding Elijah and Lailah) linked through Stellar Bond all belong to the same faction, a special resonance effect is triggered. The resonance increases linked allies' Vitality by an extra 10 and their Energy gained by 10%. After all linked allies have cast their Ultimates while resonance is active, the bond unleashes a permanent energy burst, inspiring all allies and returning them 10% of their Energy cost each time they cast their Ultimate.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.full: Elijah and Lailah increase the ATK, Phys DEF, and Magic DEF of each ally linked through Stellar Bond. The increases for each linked ally are equal to 15% of the highest corresponding stats among other linked allies, but cannot exceed 30% of the original corresponding stats of Elijah and Lailah. These stat boosts are not included when calculating increases from this skill.

skills.name: Restless Guardian
skills.lite: At the start of the battle or when actively used, Callan gains a shield that absorbs damage for allies.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Callan gains a shield and becomes . While the shield is active, Callan cannot move or act. The shield's value drops by 20% per second and can absorb 50% physical and magic damage taken by allies within a 2-tile radius. Callan enters the battle when the shield expires Active. Callan maintains the shield for up to 10s, gaining a + PWR 5% shield and becomes . During this time, the shield absorbs 50% physical or magic damage taken by allies in a 2-tile radius.

skills.name: Flail Slam
skills.lite: Callan deals damage multiple times to a target enemy, knocking the target and nearby enemies down.
skills.full: Callan swings his flail to deal ATK 160% damage to an enemy twice. He then slams them on the ground, dealing ATK 150% + PWR 20% damage to all enemies in a rectangular area in front of him and knocking them down.

skills.name: Eternal Watch
skills.lite: Callan converts the damage absorbed by his shield into golem's might. When the stored golem's might reaches a threshold, unleashes it to deal AoE damage.
skills.full: Callan converts 25% + PWR 1% of the damage absorbed by his shield into golem's might during battle. Active. Callan unleashes the stored golem's might to deal an equal amount of damage to enemies within a 2-tile radius. This skill can only be used when the amount of stored golem's might exceeds ATK 350%. Each cast consumes up to ATK 600% of the stored might, with any excess reserved for the next cast.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Callan increases his Vitality.
skills.full: Callan increases his Vitality by 11 during battle.

skills.name: Hollowed Wrath
skills.lite: When Callan or an ally's HP drops low, he unleashes a devastating attack, dealing massive damage to nearby enemies and stunning them. This skill can be used once per battle.
skills.full: When Callan or any non-summoned ally's HP falls below 30%, he lets out a wrathful howl, dealing ATK 50% damage per enemy to all enemies up to 8 times and stunning them for 0.5s. While casting this skill, Callan becomes . This skill can be used once per battle.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Callan recovers a certain amount of HP when gaining a shield.
skills.full: When gaining a shield, Callan recovers HP equal to 15% of the shield's max value.

skills.name: Frostveil Domain
skills.lite: Cryonaia summons the domain of Eternal Winter, trapping several enemies within its bound. While within the domain, Cryonaia gains various boosts.
skills.full: Cryonaia summons the domain of Eternal Winter, trapping up to 3 enemy heroes and their summon in the domain for 12s, cutting them off from the rest of the battlefield. This skill prioritizes enemy heroes who have dealt the most cumulative damage. In Boss fights, Cryonaia traps all enemies in the domain of Eternal Winter. When Cryonaia casts Frostveil Domain, she gains a Frost Shield that only lasts when Eternal Winter is active, absorbing up to ATK 1400% + PWR 250% damage. When the shield is active, Cryonaia is immune to control effects, her Haste increases by 60, her ATK increases by 60%, and she cannot be defeated. Eternal Winter will end early if all trapped enemies are defeated or if the Frost Shield is destroyed.

skills.name: Icicle Tempest
skills.lite: Cryonaia summons an ice storm that sweeps across the battlefield, dealing damage to enemies within range.
skills.full: Cryonaia summons a powerful ice storm that sweeps across the battlefield for 6s, dealing ATK 40% + PWR 7% damage every 0.5s to enemies in its path and ATK 20% + PWR 3% damage to enemies within 1 tile of the storm. After casting Frostveil Domain, Cryonaia stops using this skill actively. Instead, she creates a full-sized ice storm and two smaller ones at the center of the battlefield, which lasts for the duration of her Frost Shield. The smaller storms deal ATK 20% ATK + PWR 3% damage every 0.5s to enemies caught in their path.

skills.name: Frigid Edge
skills.lite: Cryonaia fires multiple ice shards, dealing damage to the enemy hit.
skills.full: Cryonaia creates and launches 5 ice shards at an enemy, with each shard dealing ATK 140% + PWR 20% damage to the enemy hit. While her Frost Shield is active, the cooldown of this skill is reduced to 3s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Cryonaia gains an ATK boost, which increases further the longer the Frost Shield remains active.
skills.full: Cryonaia increases her ATK by 7% during battle. For every 2s that the Frost Shield remains active, her ATK increases by an additional 1%, stacking up to 6 times.

skills.name: Frozen in Time
skills.lite: Cryonaia deals massive damage to enemies each time they are brought into the domain of Eternal Winter. Only Cryonaia can cast Ultimate while within the domain.
skills.full: Cryonaia deals ATK 60% damage to enemies each time they are brought into the domain of Eternal Winter. Only Cryonaia can cast Ultimate while within the domain.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Cryonaia instantly defeats enemies within the domain of Eternal Winter when their HP falls below a certain percentage.
skills.full: While the Frost Shield is active, Cryonaia instantly freezes and defeats enemies within the domain of Eternal Winter if their current HP is below 300% of her ATK and their HP percentage is lower than 15%.

skills.name: Gravitic Requiem
skills.lite: Cyran summons a black hole that continuously pulls enemies toward its center while dealing damage. Enemies with low HP within the center are immediately defeated.
skills.full: Cyran selects a tile and summons a black hole that lasts for 5s, with its center covering a 1-tile radius. Every 0.25s, enemies within the center take ATK 16% + PWR 2% damage, and those outside the center but within 4 tiles take ATK 6% + PWR 1% damage. All enemies on the battlefield are pulled toward the center, with the gravitational force increasing as they get closer. Non-Boss enemies within the center are immediately defeated if their current HP is below Cyran's ATK 600% + PWR 20% and their HP ratio is below 15% + PWR 1%.

skills.name: Arcane Barrage
skills.lite: Cyran casts 3 magic orbs to deal damage to enemies.
skills.full: Cyran casts 3 magic orbs towards the area with the most enemies, dealing ATK 65% + PWR 7% damage to adjacent enemies.

skills.name: Cursed Grasp
skills.lite: Cyran uses magic to lift the nearest enemy and hurls them into the area with the most enemies.
skills.full: Cyran uses magic to lift the nearest enemy into the air, imprisoning them for 1s before hurling them into the area with the most enemies. This knocks the target down for 0.5s and deals ATK 150% + PWR 10% damage to enemies within 1 tile of the target. When casting this skill, Cyran prioritizes targeting an enemy who is neither nor .

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Crit during battle.
skills.full: When in battle, Cyran increases his Crit by 18, and after defeating an enemy with Gravitic Requiem, his Crit is further increased by 12.

skills.name: Mystic Recollection
skills.lite: Cyran draws on spells from his memories, casting them when a battle starts to enhance himself an attack enemies.
skills.full: Cyran mimics some of Merlin's impressive spells, casting them in the following sequence when a battle starts: Enlightening Spell: Grants himself 30 Haste for 8s, during which he is . Confining Spell: Deals ATK 25% damage to the enemy, imprisoning them for 1.5s and preventing from moving or acting. Starshard Spell: Conjures a dark flame across the battlefield, dealing ATK 40% true damage to all enemies and reducing their ATK SPD by 20 for 5s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Gains extra Energy.
skills.full: Gains extra 200 initial Energy.

skills.name: Splashing Fun
skills.lite: Gerda heals nearby allies and puts enemies to sleep.
skills.full: Gerda uses a wooden ladle to splash spring water within a 2-tile radius, healing affected allies for ATK 120% + PWR 10% HP and dealing ATK 140% + PWR 15% damage to affected enemies. Enemies affected are put to sleep for 1s and cannot move or act. Each time a target receive healing equal to 10% of their max HP or is healed 3 times by Gerda's hot spring, the sleep extends by 0.5s up to 3s.

skills.name: Spring Therapy
skills.lite: Gerda leaps forward when a battle starts, interrupting nearby enemies and creating a hot spring.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Gerda leaps forward up to 3 tiles and stomps the ground to unleash a spring, dealing ATK 200% + PWR 20% damage with an interruption effect to enemies within 1 tile. Then she creates a hot spring within a 2-tile radius. Allies within this area recover ATK 25% + PWR 2% HP per second, while enemies recover ATK 4% HP per second (capped at 0.5% of their max HP). Gerda is while casting this skill.

skills.name: Mighty Smash
skills.lite: Gerda smashes an enemy, stunning them while gaining a shield for herself.
skills.full: Gerda smashes an enemy with a wooden ladle, dealing ATK 150% + PWR 10% damage and stunning them for 1.5s. At the same time, Gerda gains a ATK 340% + PWR 30% shield for 8s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Gerda reduces her damage taken during battle.
skills.full: Gerda reduces her damage taken by 12% during battle.

skills.name: Spring of Life
skills.lite: Gerda increases the healing received from the hot spring and reduces the cooldown of Mighty Smash whenever an ally is healed by the hot spring.
skills.full: Gerda increases the healing received from the allied hot spring by 120%. Each time an ally is healed by it, the cooldown of Mighty Smash is reduced by 0.2s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Gerda no longer interrupts enemies during Spring Therapy but stuns them instead.
skills.full: When Gerda stomps the ground during Spring Therapy, she stuns enemies for 2s instead of interrupting them.

skills.name: Unbroken Retribution
skills.lite: Athalia deals massive true damage to the enemy who has dealt the highest cumulative damage.
skills.full:
Passive. When Athalia is defeated, her unyielding resolve manifests as a lance that continues to attack enemies on the battlefield, with her ATK reduced by 35%.
Active. Athalia leaps into the air and strikes the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt, dealing ATK 150% + PWR 27% true damage plus extra true damage equal to 30% + PWR 3% of all enemies' total HP lost she has recorded. The extra true damage cannot exceed ATK 1500% + PWR 150%. Enemies hit are knocked down for 0.5s, and Athalia remains while casting this skill. After using this skill, she resets her record of enemies' HP loss to zero.

skills.name: Vengeance Charge
skills.lite: Athalia dashes to the tile behind the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt, dealing damage to the target and any enemies in the dashing path.
skills.full: Athalia targets the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt and dashes to the tile behind them. The dash deals ATK 360% + PWR 40% damage to the target and ATK 280% + PWR 30% damage to enemies in its path. Athalia is during the dash.

skills.name: Vanguard's Renewal
skills.lite: Athalia deals damage to adjacent enemies and recovers a small amount of HP.
skills.full: Athalia transforms into a lance, striking adjacent enemies 6 times, with each hit dealing ATK 20% + PWR 3% damage. While casting this skill, Athalia becomes , reduces damage taken by 60% + PWR 2%, and recovers ATK 150% + PWR 15% HP.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Crit during battle.
skills.full: Increases Crit by 12 during battle. When dealing damage to the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt, Crit is further increased by 30.

skills.name: Divine Verdict
skills.lite: Continuously using Vengeance Charge triggers Athalia to cast Sacred Slash, dealing extra damage.
skills.full: Every second use of Vengeance Charge, Athalia's dash simultaneously unleashes Sacred Slashes, striking the two with the most enemies. Each slash deals ATK 200% damage to all enemies in its paths. These slashes prioritize that do not overlap with the dash path of the Vengeance Charge that triggers them.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Reduces the target enemy's shield value.
skills.full: Vengeance Charge and Sacred Slash can reduce the target's shield value, up to ATK 800%.

skills.name: Sanctified Circle
skills.lite: Faramor summons a magic circle to deal true damage to enemies within and prevents them from recovering HP.
skills.full: Faramor consumes 250 - PWR 10 Energy to summon a 1-tile magic circle, centered on his current target, dealing ATK 210% + PWR 20% true damage to enemies caught inside. While the circle is active, he consumes 120 Energy per second to maintain it. Enemies within the circle cannot heal; every 0.5s, they take ATK 35% true damage, plus extra true damage equal to 20% of their lost HP. The extra true damage cannot exceed 240% of Faramor's ATK. If no enemies remain in the circle for 1s, the skill ends immediately.

skills.name: Glory's Embrace
skills.lite: Faramor prays, imbuing his weapon with sacred power, gaining a shield while dealing damage to his current target.
skills.full: Faramor prays to imbue his weapon with sacred power, gaining a shield that can absorb ATK 200% + PWR 20% damage while dealing ATK 250% + PWR 25% damage to his current target. The shield lasts for 6s. If Faramor has an active non-permanent stat boost from his allies while using this skill, it instead deals true damage.

skills.name: Sacred Pledge
skills.lite: Faramor blesses an ally, increasing the ATK of both himself and the ally while stunning nearby enemies within 1 tile of each.
skills.full: Passive. During battle preparation, Faramor can bless an adjacent allied hero, prioritizing those placed behind him. Active. Faramor increases ATK by 12% + PWR 1.5% for 10s for both himself and the hero he blesses, automatically reapplying the buff when it expires. Every 3s while the buff is active, Faramor also deals ATK 100% damage to enemies within 1 tile of both himself and the blessed hero, stunning the affected enemies for 0.5s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Haste during battle.
skills.full: Increases Haste by 12 during battle.

skills.name: Bitter Requiem
skills.lite: While active, the magic circle enhances Faramor's abilities and allows allies to deal extra true damage to enemies inside.
skills.full: Faramor replaces his normal attacks with Glory's Embrace while his magic circle is active, but the shield value he gains from Glory's Embrace is capped at ATK 600%. The magic circle also weakens the enemies within it, allowing allies to deal extra true damage equal to 75% of their ATK. Each ally can only trigger the true damage once every 1s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Faramor reduces the Vitality of enemies who revive within his magic circle.
skills.full: If an enemy revives within Faramor's magic circle after their HP drops to 0, Faramor will reduce their Vitality by 50.

skills.name: Dolly Defender
skills.lite: Daimon summons his guardian spirit to fight alongside him.
skills.full:
Passive. Daimon's guardian spirit, Stitchy, fights alongside him in battle, automatically attacking the enemy closest to Daimon for ATK 90% damage. Stitchy cannot be targeted or attacked, and is defeated when Daimon is defeated.
Active. Daimon commands Stitchy to unleash an X-shaped slash at the area with the most enemies, dealing true damage equal to 20% + PWR 3% of each target's max HP. This damage cannot exceed ATK 500%. Daimon and his two allies then gain a shield equal to 60% of the damage dealt, lasting for 8s.

skills.name: Playtime Plunder
skills.lite: Daimon converts enemy's HP into a shield for himself.
skills.full:
Passive. Every 8s, Stitchy unleashes a powerful attack that deals true damage to the target and adjacent enemies, equal to 20% of the target's max HP. The true damage cannot exceed ATK 400%. 100% of the damage dealt is then converted into a shield for Daimon that lasts for 8s.
Active. Daimon drains 17% + PWR 2% of an enemy's max HP and converts it into a shield for himself, lasting 8s. The shield value cannot exceed ATK 250%.

skills.name: Buddy Barrier
skills.lite: Daimon grants a portion of the shield he receives to the ally bonded to him.
skills.full: Daimon forms a bond with the ally placed behind him during battle preparation. Whenever Daimon gains a shield, the bonded ally also receives 24% + PWR 3% of that shield for the same duration. While shielded by Daimon, the bonded ally gains an extra 15 + PWR 1 Life Drain and 25% + PWR 2% ATK. If the bonded ally is defeated, Daimon will immediately bond with the ally.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Daimon reduces his damage taken, and by an extra percentage while shielded.
skills.full: Daimon reduces his damage taken by 10% during the battle. While shielded, he further reduces damage taken by an extra 5%.

skills.name: Guardian Howl
skills.lite: Stitchy's roar frightens enemies around Daimon.
skills.full: Whenever Daimon's cumulative damage taken and shield value loss combined exceed 70% of his max HP, Stitchy returns to him and lets out a terrifying roar, frightening enemies within 3 tiles. The enemy who dealt the most damage to Daimon will also be . The effect lasts for 2s and triggers once every 10s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Converts leftover shield value into HP.
skills.full: When an allied hero's shield expires, converts 50% of the remaining shield value into healing for that hero.

skills.name: Celestial Rise
skills.lite: When a battle starts, Baelran gains a shield and bonus HP that gradually decreases over time. Baelran enters the Celestial Form when he is restored to max HP. When Baelran casts this skill, he deals true damage to enemies within a 3-tile arc in front of him and restores HP.
skills.full:
Passive. When a battle starts, Baelran gains a shield equal to 80% + PWR 5% of his initial HP and receives bonus max HP. This bonus max HP does not raise Baelran's current HP and decreases by 2% every second.
When Baelran is restored to his max HP, he spreads his wings, deals damage to enemies within 2 tiles, and enters Celestial Form. While in Celestial Form, the bonus max HP no longer decreases, and his normal attacks all strike enemies within a 1-tile arc in front of him. Baelran is while receiving bonus max HP and while transitioning into Celestial Form.
Active. Baelran channels divine power into his blade, dealing ATK 280% + PWR 40% true damage to all enemies within a 3-tile arc in front of him. He then restores HP equal to 40% of the damage dealt by the active strike.

skills.name: Sanctified Surge
skills.lite: Passive. Baelran gradually restores HP during battle. In Celestial Form, his attacks deal extra true damage with each hit.
skills.full: Passive. Baelran restores HP every second. While in Celestial Form, his blade is permanently imbued with Divine Light, dealing an extra + PWR 0.3% true damage with each hit.

skills.name: Wrath Cleave
skills.lite: Baelran knocks an enemy into the air, then knocks down all enemies in a rectangular area in front of him.
skills.full: Baelran knocks his target into the air with an upward slash, dealing ATK 180% + PWR 20% damage. He then slams his sword down, dealing ATK 300% + PWR 40% damage to enemies within a 3-tile rectangular area in front of him, knocking them down for 2s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Baelran increases his Haste, and further increases it when he enters Celestial Form or enhanced Celestial Form.
skills.full: Baelran increases his Haste by 9 during battle, and further increases it by 3 when he enters Celestial Form or enhanced Celestial Form.

skills.name: Divine Dominance
skills.lite: When Baelran enters Celestial Form, he fully regains the bonus max HP granted by Celestial Rise. If he is restored to max HP again, he enters an enhanced Celestial Form, becoming unaffected permanently and empowering his Ultimate to call down Divine Light strikes that deal true damage.
skills.full:
When Baelran enters Celestial Form, he fully regains the bonus max HP granted by Celestial Rise. If he is restored to max HP again, he enters an enhanced Celestial Form, dealing true damage to enemies within 2 tiles and becoming permanently.
When casting Celestial Rise, Baelran calls down Divine Light strikes on every tile within the affected area, dealing true damage per strike. If an enemy is hit multiple times, the damage they take from each successive strike is reduced by 10%.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: The extra damage from Baelran's Sanctified Surge reduces the max HP of non-boss enemies by a set percentage, or causes extra HP loss to bosses.
skills.full: The extra damage from Baelran's Sanctified Surge can also reduce the max HP of non-boss enemies by 70% of the damage dealt. This max HP reduction cannot exceed 40% of the target's max HP or ATK 800% of Baelran's ATK, whichever is lower. When fighting against boss enemies, this skill does not reduce max HP; instead, it causes them to lose HP.

skills.name: Radiant Rain
skills.lite: Aliceth flies into the air and fires arrows at an enemy.
skills.full: Aliceth flies into the air and fires 6 volleys of 3 arrows in rapid succession at an enemy. Each arrow deals ATK 100% + PWR 10% damage, plus extra damage equal to 5% of the enemy's lost HP. The extra damage cannot exceed ATK 50%. Aliceth remains invincible while airborne.

skills.name: Guiding Light
skills.lite:
Passive. Aliceth grants an ally Brightfeather, allowing them to unleash a feather strike after dealing damage a set number of times.
Active. Aliceth strikes an enemy for heavy damage, knocking them back and stunning them.
skills.full:
Passive. Aliceth grants an ally Brightfeather, prioritizing the nearest ally in her row. After that, ally deals ranged damage 3 times, they unleash a feather for an additional strike, dealing ATK 120% + PWR 20% damage. This strike can occur once every 0.5s.
If the ally granted Brightfeather is a ranged unit, their normal attack range is increased by 5 tiles. The ally loses Brightfeather if they are defeated.
Active. Aliceth shoots a charged arrow at enemy, dealing ATK 380% + PWR 50% damage, knocking them back 6 tiles, and stunning them for 2.5s.

skills.name: Sealed Fate
skills.lite: Aliceth marks the farthest enemy. She and allies with Brightfeather will prioritize attacking the marked enemy.
skills.full:
When a battle starts, Aliceth places her Mark of Judgement on the farthest enemy. She and allies with Brightfeather both prioritize attacking the marked enemy, and their attacks against that enemy gain an extra 35 + PWR 5 Penetration.
Passive. After Aliceth locks on the same enemy for 6s or casts her Ultimte, the Mark of Judgement is enhanced. The enchanted mark allows her to instantly defeat the marked enemy if her attack reduces the enemy's HP below ATK 300% + PWR 30%. If the marked enemy is defeated or becomes untargetable, Aliceth shifts the mark to a new enemy, resetting the mark's duration counter.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Aliceth increases her ATK in battle. After the first enemy affected by her Mark of Judgement is defeated, Aliceth and allies with Brightfeather gain extra ATK.
skills.full: Aliceth increases her ATK by 9% in battle. After the first enemy affected by her Mark of Judgement is defeated, Aliceth and allies with Brightfeather gain an extra 6% ATK.

skills.name: Aegis Wings
skills.lite: The first time Aliceth or an ally with Brightfeather takes a fatal blow, Aliceth prevents their defeat.
skills.full: The first time Aliceth or an ally with Brightfeather takes a , Aliceth prevents their defeat. The affected hero instead becomes for 1.5s and recovers . Afterward, Aliceth or the ally is moved to a safe spot within 4 tiles. But allies who are or will not be moved. This skill can trigger once per hero.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Each time an ally with Brightfeather unleashes a set number of feathers, Aliceth's Ultimate is enhanced to fire additional volleys of arrows with each cast.
skills.full: For every 4 feathers unleashed by an ally with Brightfeather, Aliceth's Radiant Rain is enhanced to fire 1 extra arrow volley for the rest of the battle. Through this, she can fire up to 6 extra arrow volleys in total.

skills.name: Temporal Field
skills.lite: Galahad deals damage to all enemies and creates a magic circle that consumes Energy as it forms. When the circle reaches full power, she gains a buff. The circle stays active as long as Galahad remains at it's center. While she is at its center, whenever she casts a skill, a shadow appears that casts the same skill.
skills.full:
When Galahad casts her Ultimate, she consumes 400 Energy to deal ATK 340% + PWR 50% damage to all enemies. She then begins to forming a 2-tile-radius magic circle centered on her position. The circle remains active as long as Galahad stays in the center.
While the magic circle is forming, Galahad consumes 60 Energy second to increase the circle's forming progress by 10%. When forming progress reaches 100%, she stops consuming Energy and gains 30 Haste.
Enemies inside the circle lose 10 Haste and 16% movement speed for every 10% of the circle's forming progress, up to a max reduction of 50 Haste and 80% movement speed.
While Galahad stays at the center of her circle, whenever she casts a skill, a shadow of herself appears shortly after and casts the same skill. The shadow inherits 60% + PWR 5% of Galahad's stats.

skills.name: Binding Loop
skills.lite: Galahad immobilizes the enemy who has delt the most cumulative damage, causing them to lose HP based on the healing they recived. Then she deals damage to enemies in a wider range.
skills.full:
Galahad deals ATK 210% + PWR 30% damage to the enemy who has delt the most cumulative damage and immobilizes them for 4s. The immobilized target cannot move or act and loses HP equal to 50% of non-excess healing they have recived since they were last immobilized by this skill; the HP loss cannot exceed ATK 500%. In boss fight, the HP loss becomes fixed at ATK 125%.
After the initial strike, Galahad expands this skill's range by 1 tile and deals ATK 140% + PWR 20% damage to all enemies within range, she repeats this sequence for a third strike.

skills.name: Chrono Ward
skills.lite: Galahad grants a shield to the weakest ally. When the shield expires, it deals damage to nearby enemies.
skills.full: Galahad casts a protection spell on the ally, granting them a ATK 480% + PWR 40% shield that lasts for 8s. When the shield expires, it deals ATK 240% + PWR 20% damage to adjacent enemies.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Galahad increases her ATK, with an extra ATK increas when her magic circle is fully formed.
skills.full: Galahad increases her ATK by 9% during battle. She also gains an extra 6% ATK when her magic circle is fully formed.

skills.name: Time Recast
skills.lite: Once the magic circle is fully formed, Galahad summons a shadow of an allied hero from the start of the battle to fight alongside her for a while.
skills.full:
When a battle starts, Galahad marks the nearest allied hero, priortizing the one behind her. When Galahad's magic circle is fully formed for the first time, she summons a shadow that recreates the marked ally as they were at the start of battle.
The shadow remains on the battlefield for 12s, inheriting 80 of the ally's basic stats and starting with 400 extra Initial Energy. A shadow is not considered a living hero and cannot be targeted by enemies.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Galahad continuously recovers Energy and becomes steadfast while affected by Merlin's buffs.
skills.full: While Galahad is affected by Merlin's buffs, she recovers 40 Energy per second and becomes . The effect granted by this skill cannot exceed a total of 30s.

skills.name: Winter Anthem
skills.lite: Alna summons a blizzard to reduce enemies' Haste and deal damage over time.
skills.full:
'''Passive.''' When a battle starts, Alna blankets the battlefield in frost, reducing Haste by 40 and range by 2 tiles for all units except herself.
'''Active.''' Alna lets out a battle cry and summons a blizzard, which removes the Haste buffs from all enemies and deals ATK 40% + PWR 6% damage to each enemy every 0.5s for 8s. While the blizzard is active, when Alna or the Winter Warrior takes damage, they recover 50% + PWR 5% of the HP lost from that damage over the next 10s.

skills.name: Shared Resolve
skills.lite: Alna appoints a Winter Warrior and grants them buffs.
skills.full:
During battle preparation, Alna selects an ally placed in the same row as herself to become the Winter Warrior. That ally is immune to Winter Anthem's Haste reduction effect, and their max HP is permanently increased by 15% + PWR 1.5%.
'''Active.''' Alna thrusts her spear to deal ATK 340% + PWR 40% damage to enemies, restoring 100% + PWR 10% HP to herself and the Winter Warrior.

skills.name: Wild Whirl
skills.lite: Alna sweeps her spear, dealing damage to nearby enemies and reducing their Haste.
skills.full: Alna repeatedly swings her spear, striking enemies within a 1-tile arc in front of her twice, with each hit dealing ATK 120% + PWR 15% damage. She then sweeps her spear around, dealing ATK 240% + PWR 30% damage to all surrounding enemies and reducing their Haste by 50 for 8s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Reduce damage taken; damage reduction increases as the battle continues.
skills.full: Reduces the damage taken by 10% during battle. For every 10s the battle lasts, the damage reduction increases by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.

skills.name: Chilling Presence
skills.lite: Alna calls upon the protection of icy winds, becoming immune to damage and control effects.
skills.full: When a battle starts and every 20s thereafter, Alna envelops herself in icy winds, becoming immune to damage and control effects for 4s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Alna and her Winter Warrior gain a stat buff. The first time either of them leaves the Chilling Presence state, Alna or the Winter Warrior freezes nearby enemies.
skills.full: Alna and her Winter Warrior gain a 15% increase to their basic stats until one of them is defeated. The first time either of them leaves the Chilling Presence state, Alna or the Winter Warior will freeze enemies within 1 tile for 2s and reduce those enemies' Vitality by 50 for 10s.

skills.name: Starlit Slumber
skills.lite: Aurora falls asleep and becomes invincible, summoning her unicorn Sonny to strengthen allied summons and attack enemies.
skills.full:
Aurora summons her unicorn Sonny to her side and drifts into a deep sleep. Sonny inherits 140% + PWR 20% of Aurora's HP and 120% + PWR 10% of her other basic stats, then creates a rainbow aura that inspires allies. All inspired allied summons gain 50 Haste, and their movement becomes smoother, letting them move past enemies and obstacles more easily. This skill can be cast even when Aurora is under control effects.
While asleep, Aurora stays . For normal attacks, she conjures objects from her dreams and hurls them at enemies to deal ATK 320% damage. If Sonny gets defeated in battle, Aurora jolts awake. Once awaken, she becomes vulnerable to enemy attacks and can't use any skills except her Ultimate.
'''Passive.''' When a battle starts, Aurora immediately falls asleep, and Sonny appears at her side. The frontmost enemy hero gets marked as the Nightmare. The mark reduces their Haste by 40, but increases their ATK 2%. Sonny rallies all allied summons to focus their attacks on the Nightmare.

skills.name: Dreamspark Bunny
skills.lite: Aurora summons a magical bunny that attacks enemies. The bunny detonates when its duration ends, dealing AoE damage.
skills.full:
This skill can only be used while Aurora is asleep. Aurora summons a magical bunny beside her that lasts for up to 12s. The magical bunny inherits 100% + PWR 10% of Aurora's HP and 80% + PWR 8% of her other basic stats, and deals ATK 100% damage with its normal attacks.
When the magical bunny's duration ends, it leaps at the nearest enemy within 2 tiles and detonates, dealing ATK 340% + PWR 40% damage to all adjacent enemies.

skills.name: Plushification
skills.lite: If an enemy stays near Aurora long enough, they will be transformed into a unicorn plushie for a while.
skills.full: While Aurora is dreaming, reality within 2 tiles around her slowly gets overtaken by her dream. If an enemy stays in that area for 12s, they will be transformed into a unicorn plushie, leaving them unable to move or attack for 1 + PWR 0.125s. The longer an enemy remains in the area, the faster each subsequent transformation triggers (minimum 6s. This effect does not apply to enemies.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Aurora increases her ATK. For every allied summon from a different ally on the battlefield, her ATK increases further.
skills.full: Aurora increases her ATK by 10% during battle. For every allied summon from a different ally on the battlefield, her ATK increases further by 1%, up to 5 times.

skills.name: Dream Veil
skills.lite: While Aurora is asleep, allied summons are enhanced, and Sonny becomes unaffected.
skills.full:
While asleep, Aurora opens her whimsical Dream Theater, boosting the damage of all allied summons by 4% and casting them in special roles.
Melee summons all take on the role of powerful Knights and take 25% less damage.
Ranged summons take on the role of graceful Princesses, allowing their normal attacks to deal extra damage equal to 20% of Aurora's ATK.
As for Sonny, Aurora's unicorn friend, he plays the role of the Prince. He gets both the Knight's and Princess' buff and becomes .

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: If Aurora's Energy is above a certain threshold while she's asleep, the range of Plushification increases.
skills.full: If Aurora's Energy is above 500 while she's asleep, she enters a deeper sleep, expanding the range of Plushification to a 3-tile radius.

skills.name: Intel Chase
skills.lite: When a battle starts, Evie conceals herself on the enemy side to gather intel. When this skill is actively used, Evie interrogates and immobilizes an enemy. If she has already gathered intel on them, they are also silenced.
skills.full:
Passive. When a battle starts, Evie teleports to the symmetrical tile on the enemy side and enters concealment. While concealed, Evie is and accumulates 120 Detection points every second. She loses 500 Detection points each time an ally casts their Ultimate. When her Detection reaches 1000, or if all allies are defeated, Evie is revealed and no longer .
As soon as Evie enters concealment. she starts gathering intel on all non-summoned enemies within 1 tile. Once complete, she continues investigating the remaining non-summoned enemies one at a time, prioritizing from nearest to farthest based on their starting positions relative to her. Each investigation takes 4.5s, and when it is completed, Evie gains 150 Energy.
After gathering intel on all those enemies, Evie teleports back to her original tile and loses her .
Active. Evie interrogates the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt for 6s. During the interrogation, she deals ATK 180% + PWR 18% damage to the enemy every second and them. If she has already gathered intel on the target, the skill also silences them during the interrogation.

skills.name: Pointed Proof
skills.lite: Evie reduces the Magic DEF of enemies she has gathered intel on. When this skill is actively used, she dashes to the nearest enemy and deals damage to them twice.
skills.full:
Passive. When Evie finishes gathering intel on an enemy hero, that enemy hero's Magic DEF is permanently reduced by 20% + PWR 2%.
If she manages to gather intel on all surviving enemy heroes while concealed, the Magic DEF of all enemies is reduced by an extra 25% + PWR 2.5%.
Active. Evie dashes to the nearest enemy and strikes them twice with her dagger. dealing ATK 220%damage with each hit.

skills.name: Foretold Favor
skills.lite: Evie sends a quill to follow an ally, buffing and healing them.
skills.full:
When a battle starts, Evie summons a quill to follow the rearmost ally. Afterward, every 3s, the quill switches to the ally with the highest cumulative damage dealt, restoring ATK 120% HP to them every second and increasing their ATK by 20% + PWR 2%.
When the ally with the quill has dealt damage equal to 250% of their initial ATK, the quill shoots 1 healing orb at each of the 2 weakest allies other than the ally the quill is following. restoring ATK 45% + PWR 6% HP to them. The effect can trigger once every 0.5s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Healing during battle.
skills.full: Increases Healing by 11 during battle.

skills.name: Tactical Briefing
skills.lite: After gathering intel on all enemies, Evie inflicts debuffs on them.
skills.full: If Evie gathers intel on every surviving enemy hero without being revealed, she shares her findings with her allies. With their weaknesses exposed, these enemies deal 25% less damage for the rest of the battle. In non-boss battles, the duration of dispellable debuffs inflicted on allies by these enemies is also reduced by 30%.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: After gathering intel on all enemies, Evie sends out an extra quill.
skills.full: After gathering intel on all surviving enemy heroes while concealed, Evie summons an extra quill to follow the ally with the second-highest cumulative damage dealt. Each ally can only be followed by one quill.

skills.name: Detention Pass
skills.lite:
When a battle starts, Contess hides within her rulebook and continuously recovers Energy.
Active. Contess restores a large amount of HP to an ally and grants them Exemption, preventing them from being punished by Contess for rule violations. The ally also continuously converts their own HP into a shield.
skills.full:
Passive. When a battle starts, Contess hides within her rulebook. While hidden, she cannot move or act, cannot be targeted by enemies, and recovers 66 Energy every second.
She enters the battlefield when her Energy is full, when an enemy violates a rule, or when all other allies are defeated.
Active. Contess restores ATK 666% + PWR 66% HP to a target ally and grants them Exemption.
Exemption: Prevents the target ally from being punished by allied Contess for rule violations. While the ally's HP ratio is above 40%, they lose 2.5% of their max HP every second, converting 200% of the lost amount into a shield. The shield value cannot exceed 100% of the ally's max HP. While this shield is active, the ally's ATK is increased by 30%.
When auto battle is enabled, this skill prioritizes the ally with the most cumulative damage dealt who has not yet received Exemption. If all allies have already received Exemption, it instead targets the ally.

skills.name: Mandatory Civility
skills.lite:
While Contess is on the battlefield, she disciplines those who violate school rules.
Code of Conduct - Be Civil
When a unit on the battlefield loses a certain amount of HP or shield value, the enemy unit that contributed the most damage to that loss is deemed to have violated this rule.
Active. Contess heals several weakest allies and reduces the ATK of enemies with the most cumulative damage dealt for a duration.
skills.full:
While Contess is on the battlefield, she disciplines those who violate school rules, reducing their max HP by 6.6% + PWR 0.6%.
Max HP reduced cannot exceed ATK 100% + PWR 10%.
Code of Conduct - Be Civil
When a unit on the battlefield loses 60% max HP or shield value in total (the lost amount cannot exceed 150% of the initial Team ATK). the enemy unit that contributed the most damage to that loss is deemed in violation of this rule. Each unit may violate this rule 5 times within 10s.
If the unit violating this rule is an ally, Contess also heals the allied unit for ATK 200% HP in addition to the punishment.
In Boss battles, this rule is enforced differently: Every 10s, the unit with the most cumulative damage dealt on each side is considered in violation of this rule.
Active. Contess restores ATK 150% + PWR 20% HP to the 2 allies, and reduces the ATK of the 2 enemies with the most cumulative damage dealt by 25% for 6s.

skills.name: Quiet Period
skills.lite:
Code of Conduct - Be Quiet
Whenever a unit casts their Ultimate, that unit is deemed in violation of this rule.
Active. Contess reduces the Energy recovery efficiency of several enemies who have cast the most Ultimates. This effect lasts for a set duration.
skills.full:
Code of Conduct - Be Quiet
Whenever a unit casts their Ultimate, that unit is deemed in violation of this rule. A unit may only violate this rule once every 6s.
Active. Contess reduces Energy recovery efficiency by 14% + PWR 2% for the 2 enemies who have cast the most Ultimates. This effect lasts 6s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: When an enemy violates a school rule, Contess permanently reduces their ATK and Energy recovery efficiency.
skills.full:
When an enemy violates a school rule, Contess permanently reduces their ATK by 2% and Energy recovery efficiency by 1%.
The reductions from this effect cannot exceed 10% for ATK and 5% for Energy recovery efficiency.

skills.name: Expulsion Notice
skills.lite: Contess expels a unit when they're punished a set number of times. Expelled units are permanently silenced, even if they are unaffected, and take increased HP loss.
skills.full: Contess permanently expels a unit when they're punished more than 6 times. Expelled units are permanently silenced, even if they are unaffected (ineffective against Bosses), and take 18% more HP loss. Allies granted Exemption by Contess are not affected by this effect.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Contess punishes enemies who violate a school rule with an extra effect.
skills.full:
In regular battles, Contess stuns enemies who violate Code of Conduct - Be Civil for 2s, and silences enemies who violate Code of Conduct - Be Quiet for 6s.
In Boss battles, Contess punishes enemies who violate a school rule one extra time.

skills.name: Heart of the Lake
skills.lite: The Falling Starcore sacrifices some of its HP to strike enemies with a water orb.
skills.full:
'''Passive.''' The Falling Starcore inherits the team's average ATK, Phys DEF, and Magic DEF, ad its HP is equal to 500% of initial Team ATK. It's immune to Lady Starfallen's attack and to any effects that alter max HP.
When a battle starts, the Falling Starcore begins in an uncharged state with only 10% of its max HP. Whenever its current HPratio exceeds 20%, it immediately consumes 20% of its max HP to conjure a water orb and launch the orb at Lady Starfallen, dealing true damage equal to 40% of Team ATK.

skills.name: Frost Ring
skills.lite: The Falling Starcore forms a ring of ice shards around the enemy and quickly contracts it.
skills.full: After casting Heart of the Lake 4 times, the Falling Starcore forms a ring of ice shards around Lady Starfallen and quickly contracts it, causing HP loss equal to 30% of Team ATK to her. This effect triggers up to 1 time every 15s.

skills.name: Crystal Ward
skills.lite: The Falling Starcore grants shields to the two units on your team with the highest healing done, making them unaffected.
skills.full: Each time Lady Starfallen casts Ultimate, the Falling Starcore immediately grants shields to the two units on your team with the highest healing. These shields absorb damage equal to 100% of Team ATK and make the shielded units unaffected for 10s.

skills.name: Lightning: Judradjim
skills.lite: When a battle starts, Frieren conceals her magic. After a short time, she amplifies her magic power, increasing her damage and replacing her normal attack with Lightning: Judradjim, which deals higher damage and can stun enemies.

skills.name: Hellfire: Vollzanbel

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases ATK during battle.
skills.full: Frieren increases her ATK by 9% during battle. After amplifying her magic power, she increases her ATK by an extra 6%.

skills.name: Defensive Spell
skills.lite: Frieren reduces damage taken by herself and the frontmost ally.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Frieren knocks the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt into the air before knocking them down.
skills.full: 5s after Frieren amplifies her magic power, she knocks the enemy with the most cumulative damage dealt into the air and hurls them toward the edge of the battlefield, dealing ATK 800% damage and knocking them down for 2s.

skills.name: Funereal Ring
skills.lite: Igor deals damage to all enemies.
skills.full: Igor summons a tombstone where he stands when a battle starts. Everytime an enemy hero losses 40% of thier HP, Igor summons another tombstone on an empty tile closest to this enemy which will disappear after receiving 3 normal attacks. Igor will always stand on the tombstone and remain . Igor deals ATK 150% + PWR 20% damage to all enemies upon casting this skill.

skills.name: Ghastly Explosion
skills.lite: Igor jumps onto an activated tombstone, dealing damage to nearby enemies and then deactivating the tombstone.
skills.full: Igor activates all tombstones every 8s or whenever he casts Funereal Ring. If he jumps onto a tombstone activated by Funereal Ring, he deals an extra 50% damage.

skills.name: Specter Guard
skills.lite: Igor jumps onto another tombstone to dodge a fatal blow, recovering HP while moving between tombstones.
skills.full: Igor jumps onto anoter tombstone to dodge a fatal blow and gains damage immunity while using this skill. Each time Igor uses Ghastly Explosion or Specter Guard to jump between tombstones, he recovers + PWR 0.8% HP. After casting Specter Guard 6 times, each subsequent cast increases the HP loss ration required to summon a tombstone with Funereal Ring by 12%. herself

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Igor increases his Life Drain during battle, with an extra increase when triggering Specter Guard for the first time.
skills.full: Igor increases his Life Drain by 7 during battle. His Life Drain is increased by an extra 6 when triggering Specter Guard for the first time.

skills.name: Horror Strike
skills.lite: Igor extends the range of Ghastly Explosion when his HP ratio is above a certain limit.
skills.full: Igor extends the range of Ghastly Explosion by 1 tile and reduces the target's healing received by 50% for 4s when his HP ratio is above 70%.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Igor summons an extra tombstone with Funereal Ring when a battle starts.
skills.full: Igor summons an extra tombstone with Funereal Ring on the tile with the most surrounding enemies when a battle starts.

skills.name: Full Energy
skills.lite: Koko grants allies a brief DMG Reduction and stats boost.
skills.full: Koko inspires herself and all allies, granting them a 45% DMG Reduction for 12s. After the duration of Full Energy ends, the recorded damage will be dealt as true damage to all allies. When the skill takes effect, allies gain 30 + PWR 3 Life Drain and 10% ATK. While active, the effect cannot be dispelled and prevents Koko from recasting the skill.

skills.name: Fulfilling Feast
skills.lite: Koko feeds an ally or herself with meat, recovering HP and increasing some stats.
skills.full: Koko feeds the ally, healing them by ATK 230% + PWR 20% HP and granting them 10% ATK for 5s. Koko also feeds Patto to recover ATK 350% HP every 15s, increasing 20 Energy on Hit for 7s.

skills.name: Patto, smash!
skills.lite: Koko deals high-value damage and inflicts debuffs.
skills.full: Koko throws a mighty spear at the target, dealing ATK 210% + PWR 15% damage and increasing their damage taken by 10% in the next 5s. If there's an enemy within her adjacent tiles, Patto will smash the ground, dealing ATK 210% + PWR 15% damage to adjacent enemies and stunning them for 3s. This effects can only be triggered once every 8s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Haste during battle.
skills.full: Increase Haste by 12 during battle.

skills.name: Fluffy Shield
skills.lite: Koko gains an extra shield when casting Ultimate.
skills.full: After the damage recorded in Full Energy has been settled, all allies gain a shield for 7s that can absorb damage equal to 15% of the total damage dealt by allies affected by Full Energy when it's active.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Increases the target's Vitality for a while after Koko feeds them using Fulfilling Feast.
skills.full: Increases the target's Vitality by 25 for 6s after Koko feeds them using Fulfilling Feast.

skills.name: Devastating Axe
skills.lite: Kruger launches a mighty slash to knock down an enemy and reduces their Phys DEF.
skills.full: Kruger launches a mighty slash to knock down an enemy for 1.5s, dealing ATK 450% + PWR 50% damage and inflicting them with 3 stacks of Shatter Armor. Each stack reduces the target's Phys DEF by 10%, up to 4 stacks on a target.

skills.name: Smashing Assault
skills.lite: Kruger attacks an enemy, reducing their Phys DEF.
skills.full: Kruger slashes an enemy, dealing ATK 240% damage and inflicting them with a stack of Shatter Armor.

skills.name: Vital Strike
