This extra damage cannot exceed ATK 200% of Hodgkin's ATK. The targeted enemies also lose 200 Energy.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Hodgkin reduces the Phys DEF of enemies hit by the cannon.
skills.full: Hodgkin reduces the Phys DEF of enemies hit by the cannon by 15%, up to 2 stacks, for 10s.

skills.name: Unstoppable!
skills.lite: Hugin increases the ATK and Haste of the ally with the highest cumulative damage dealt.
skills.full:
'''Passive.''' Hugin sets his anvil on the tile where he is placed during battle preparation. As his normal attacks and skills require the anvil, he will remain near it throughout the battle and will always return to it if displaced.
'''Active.''' Hugin forges a Gear of Might for the ally dealing the highest cumulative damage, boosting their combat strength. The gear increases the ally's ATK by 6% + PWR 1% of Hugin's base ATK and increases their Haste by 80 for 10s.

skills.name: Titan's Aegis
skills.lite: Hugin grants a shield to the weakest ally.
skills.full: Hugin crafts a cogshield for the weakest ally, allowing them to block ATK 600% + PWR 60% damage for 8s.

skills.name: Mechanized Bond
skills.lite: Hugin increases the ATK of the ally 1 tile behind him. The buffed ally also recovers Energy whenever Hugin casts Titan's Aegis.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Hugin etches a mechanical sigil one tile behind him, granting ally on this tile an ATK bonus equal to 14% + PWR 2% of Hugin's base ATK. The buffed ally recovers an extra 75 Energy whenever Hugin casts Titan's Aegis. This buff disappears when the ally leaves the sigil.

skills.name: Hero Focus Hugin
skills.lite: Increases Haste during battle.
skills.full: Increases Haste by 12 during battle.

skills.name: Steelbound Kinship
skills.lite: When casting Unstoppable!, Hugin grants shields to the 2 weakest allies.
skills.full: Hugin crafts enhanced cogshields for the 2 weakest allies when casting Unstoppable!, granting each with a shield that blocks ATK 800% damage for 8s.

skills.name: Enhance Force Hugin
skills.lite: While active, the shield Hugin grants also reduces the protected ally's damage taken.
skills.full: While the cogshield or enhanced cogshield is active, the protected ally also takes 30% less damage.

skills.name: Vicious Bite
skills.lite: Harak viciously strikes an enemy, dealing continuous damage and preventing them from recovering HP.
skills.full: Harak launches a vicious assault, striking an enemy 10 times, each dealing ATK 60% + PWR 10% damage. Each strike also deals extra damage equal to 6% of the enemy's lost HP, up to 120% of Harak's own ATK. The final strike deals ATK 200% + PWR 20% damage and knocks the enemy down. While casting this skill, Harak remains and prevents the enemy from recovering HP for 6s, causing them to lose ATK 40% HP per second.

skills.name: Tidal Assault
skills.lite: Harak swiftly reaches the weakest enemy, dealing damage and knocking them into the air.
skills.full: Harak dives beneath the surface, swiftly reaching the , and each assist or defeat resets Tidal Assault's cooldown.

skills.name: Flesh Feast
skills.lite: Harak enters feast mode when a battle starts, significantly enhancing his combat abilities. Assisting or defeating a unit resets the duration of feast mode. Upon exiting feast mode, Harak loses control and indiscriminately devours a non-summoned unit.
skills.full:
Passive. Harak enters feast mode when a battle starts, increasing Crit by 35 + PWR 6 and Haste by 50 for 12s. Assissting and defeating a unit resets the duration of feast mode.
Upon exiting feast mode, Harak loses control and indiscriminately devours the non-summoned unit, whether ally or enemy, instantly defeating them. During this time, he is . Harak cannot devour an enemy whose HP exceeds ATK 200% of his own ATK. In Boss fights, if attempting to devour an ally, Harak prioritizes devouring the unit positioned closest to the front at the start of the battle.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Harak increases his Life Drain during battle, with additional gains upon assisting or defeating enemies.
skills.full: Harak increases Life Drain by 8 during battle. Each time he assists or defeats an enemy, he gains an extra 1 Life Drain, up to a maximum of 4.

skills.name: Ravenous Digestion
skills.lite: Harak Increases his ATK and max HP when assisting or defeating a unit
skills.full: Upon assisting or defeating a unit, Harak gains 60% of their ATK and 60% of their max HP, up to 220% of his base ATK and 220% of his max HP.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Upon assisting or defeating a number of units, Harak recovers Energy from casting Vicious Bite.
skills.full: Upon assisting or defeating 2 units, Harak recovers 700 Energy from casting Vicious Bite.

skills.name: Whispering Tempest
skills.lite: Lorsan summons a storm, dealing continuous damage to enemies within its range and reducing their Haste.
skills.full: Lorsan channels his power to summon a storm centered on the enemy, lasting for 5s. Enemies within 2 tiles of the target are affected by the storm, suffering a 30 + PWR 3 Haste reduction and taking from ATK 50% + PWR 6% damage from Lorsan every 0.5s.

skills.name: Stormbound Retribution
skills.lite: When a battle starts, Lorsan links the nearest and farthest enemy heroes to each other with Stormbound Chain.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Lorsan links the nearest and farthest enemy heroes to each other with Stormbound Chain. The chain transfers 70% + PWR 10% of the damage taken by one of the linked enemies to the other. Damage transferred by the chain cannot exceed 500% of Lorsan's ATK and will not defeat the enemy. The chain breaks when its total damage dealt to both enemies reaches 900% of Lorsan's initial ATK, or if one of the linked enemies is defeated.

skills.name: Zephyr's Embrace
skills.lite: Lorsan continuously recovers HP for the weakest ally while increasing their Dodge and Haste.
skills.full: Lorsan protects the ally with Zephyr's Embrace for 6s. While active, the protected ally gains 50 , 30 + PWR 3 Haste, and recovers ATK 90% + PWR 12% HP per second.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Lorsan increases his ATK in battle. When Stormbound Chain breaks for the first time, his ATK is further increased.
skills.full: Lorsan increases his ATK by 9% during battle. When Stormbound Chain breaks for the first time, Lorsan's ATK is increased by an extra 6%.

skills.name: Turbulent Resurgence
skills.lite: When Stormbound Chain breaks, Lorsan heals all allies then casts Stormbound Chain again.
skills.full: Lorsan recovers ATK 200% of HP for all allies when Stormbound Chain breaks. He will then cast Stormbound Chain again, with a maximum of 3 casts per battle.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Zephyr's Embrace also makes the protected target unaffected.
skills.full: While Zephyr's Embrace is active, the protected target becomes .

skills.name: Radiant Slash
skills.lite: Slashes enemies with a greatsword. Ancient Blessings will enhance the effects of this skill.
skills.full: Charges before leaping and slamming the ground in front dealing ATK 600% damage to enemies. If Wargolem has 3 or more stacks of Ancient Blessing when using this skill, the slam is empowered, increasing its damage to ATK 900%.

skills.name: Nightpiercer
skills.lite: Unleashes a sword shock at the target. Ancient Blessings will enhance the effects of this skill.
skills.full: Charges briefly before unleashing a radiant sword shock, dealing ATK 300% damage. If Wargolem has 3 more stacks of Ancient Blessing when using the skill, the sword shock is followed by a swift thrust, striking for an extra ATK 350% damage.

skills.name: Ancient Blessing
skills.lite: Gains Ancient Blessings to enhance skills.
skills.full: Gains 1 stack of Ancient Blessing upon receiving a non-permanent buff from an ally. The Ancient Blessing stack increases damage dealt by 5% and vanishes 3s after the buff expires. Each ally can trigger this effect only once.

skills.name: Fountain Aegis
skills.lite: Adopts the team's average stats and resurrects upon defeat.
skills.full: Wargolem's HP, ATK, and DEF are set to the team's averages and the damage dealt to enemy Wargolem is increased to 2000%. When struck by a , Wargolem deactivates for a brief moment before reactivating with full HP.

skills.name: Sword and Shield
skills.lite: Guywin slashes and stuns enemies.
skills.full: Guywin swings a shield, dealing ATK 120% damage to enemies and stunning them for 2s. He then deals ATK 180% damage to them with a sword.

skills.name: Defense Stance
skills.lite: Guywin increases his Phys DEF and Magic DEF for a short time.
skills.full: Guywin increases his Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 15% for 6s.

skills.name: Heavy Cleave
skills.lite: Guywin charges up and damages enemies.
skills.full: Guywin charges up and deals ATK 180% damage to enemies.

skills.name: Hailing Arrows
skills.lite: Joey shoots arrows at the target area, dealing damage to multiple enemies.
skills.full: Joey shoots a powerful arrow at the target area, dealing ATK 150% damage to up to 5 enemies in range.

skills.name: Rapid Shooting
skills.lite: Joey shoots 2 arrows quickly, dealing damage to enemies.
skills.full: Joey shoots 2 arrows quickly. Each arrow deals ATK 60% damage to enemies.

skills.name: Target Focus
skills.lite: Joey increases his ATK SPD for a short time.
skills.full: Joey increases his ATK SPD by 20 for 8s.

skills.name: Celestial Spirit Summon
skills.lite: Lucy calls out Aquarius, a Celestial Spirit, to assist her in battle. Aquarius inherits some of Lucy's stats. Upon entering battle, Aquarius immediately starts a water swirl attack that deals AoE damage, knocks enemies into the air, and stuns them. This water swirl attack repeats at regular intervals.
skills.full: Lucy calls out Aquarius, a Celestial Spirit, to assist her in battle. Aquarius has 120% of Lucy's max HP and 100% of Lucy's other stats. Upon entering battle, Aquarius immediately conjures a water swirl that strikes the 1-tile area with the most enemies, dealing ATK 300% + PWR 30% damage to all enemies in the area. The affected enemies are knocked into the air and stunned for 2s. The water swirl attack repeats every 10s. Aquarius' normal attack deals ATK 100% + PWR 10% damage with a range of 10 tiles.

skills.name: Lucy Kick
skills.lite: Lucy kicks the enemy who has dealt the most cumulative damage, dealing damage and stunning them.
skills.full: Lucy delivers a powerful kick to the enemy who has dealt the most cumulative damage, dealing ATK 240% + PWR 20% damage and stunning them for 2.5s. After the kick, she returns to her original tile. Lucy remains while using this skill.

skills.name: Star Dress: Aquarius Form
skills.lite: Lucy's Ultimate transforms her into Aquarius. While in this form, she conjures water swirls to deal AoE damage, knocking enemies into the air, and stun them.
skills.full: Lucy's Ultimate transforms her into Aquarius for the rest of the battle. While in this form, she conjures water swirls that strike the 1-tile area with the most enemies, dealing ATK 300% + PWR 30% damage to all enemies in the area. The water swirl also knocks enemies into the air and stuns them for 2s. In Aquarius form, Lucy's attack range extends to 10 tiles.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Haste during battle.
skills.full: Increases Haste by 12 during battle.

skills.name: Water Barrier
skills.lite: Aquarius, or Lucy in Aquarius form, can cast Water Barrier to grant a shield to the weakest ally.
skills.full: Aquarius, or Lucy in Aquarius form, can cast Water Barrier to grant a shield that blocks ATK 450% damage to the ally, lasting 8s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: When Lucy reaches full Energy while Aquarius is on the battlefield, Aquarius' ATK SPD increases.
skills.full: When Lucy reaches full Energy while Aquarius is on the battlefield, Aquarius' ATK SPD increases by 80.

skills.name: Blast Mayhem
skills.lite: All of Kulu's skills deal damage to both enemies and allies. When used actively, she will relentless bombard the enemy side of the battlefield.
skills.full:
Passive. Kulu's normal attacks trigger an explosion that deals ATK 80% damage to the target and all adjacent units. All of Kulu's skills deal damage to both enemies and allies, but allies take 70% reduced damage.
Active. Kulu unleashes her fury, bombarding the enemy side of the battlefield 14 times. Each strike hits a random tile, dealing ATK 90% + PWR 10% damage to all units on the target tile and its surrounding area within 1 tile. At least 10 strikes will hit areas with 1 or more enemies within, and at least 6 of those will target the area with the most enemies. After the bombardment, Kulu summons a gigantified Boomboom to deal ATK 250% + PWR 25% damage to all units on the enemy ide of the battlefield.
Kulu only casts her Ultimate if there are enemies present on their side of the battlefield. She becomes while casting her Ultimate.

skills.name: Demolition Zone
skills.lite: When a battle starts, Kulu bombs the enemy's border tiles closest your side, creating debris that restricts movement. When used actively, she deals damage to an enemy and knocks them into the air.
skills.full:
Passive. When a battle starts, Kulu bombs the enemy's border tiles closest to your side, creating debris that restricts movement and knocks back units on the affect tiles towards their own side of the battlefield. Debris blocking the center tile can be destroyed in 6 + ATK 1 hits, but debris on the other tiles are indestructible.
Whenever the center debris is destroyed, Kulu marks the tile for an explosion that detonates after 8s, covering it with debris once again.
Active. Kulu teleports to the nearest enemy, dealing ATK 150% + PWR 20% damage to that enemy and knocking them into the air. She then returns to her original tile. If the target is on the allied side of the battlefield, Kulu knocks the enemy back toward their side by up to 3 tiles instead of knocking them into the air. Kulu is while casting this skill.

skills.name: Boomboom Bash!
skills.lite: Kulu summons Boomboom to devour 2 frontmost enemies an deliver them to the enemy side of the battlefield, triggering a series of explosions as it bounces.
skills.full: Kulu summons Boomboom, which bounces 3 times between enemies. The first 2 bounces will target the 2 enemies, devouring them. For the final bounce, Boomboom will target 1 enemy on the enemy side of the battlefield and release all devoured enemies upon impact. Each bounce deals ATK 110% + PWR 10% damage to its target and adjacent units, reducing their movement speed by 60% for 3s. Devoured enemies cannot act or act and will only take damage from Boomboom. If Boomboom could not find a valid target for the final bounce, it will instead travel 3 tiles deeper into the enemy side, unless blocked by terrain or the battlefield edges.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases ATK, with extra ATK increases when dealing damage to enemies.
skills.full: Increases ATK by 6% during battle. Dealing damage to enemies will increase ATK by an extra 0.6%, stacking up to 50 times.

skills.name: Bombs Away!
skills.lite: Kulu applies an explosive debuff to all enemies, turning them into doom bombs when they're defeated.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Kulu applies an explosive debuff to all enemies, increasing their damage taken by 10%, which lasts until the end of the battle. When an enemy with the explosive debuff is defeated, Kulu turns them into a doom bomb that detonates after 2s. The explosion deals ATK 210% damage to all enemy units within 2 tiles, plus extra damage equal to 15% of the defeated enemy's initial HP. The extra damage cannot exceed ATK 300% of Kulu's ATK.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Kulu gains extra ATK SPD and Ranged DEF during battle, with the values based on the number of enemies on her half of the battlefield.
skills.full: Kulu gains extra ATK SPD and Ranged DEF during battle. If there are no enemies on Kulu's half of the battlefield, her ATK SPD increases by 40 and her Ranged DEF increases by 40. For each enemy present on Kulu's half of the battlefield, the buff values decrease by 10, down to 20. Other allies on Kulu's half of the battlefield receive a portion of these buffs, benefiting by 50% of their values.

skills.name: Spellbane Shot
skills.lite: Indris fires a silencing arrow at an enemy, preventing their stats from increasing for a while and reducing their Phys & Magic DEF for the rest of the battle.
skills.full: Indris fires a silencing arrow at an enemy, dealing ATK 240% + PWR 20% damage. The shot disables the enemy's stat buffs for 8s and reduces their Phys & Magic DEF by 20% for the rest of the battle. Unstackable. The buff-disabling effect doesn't work on Bosses.

skills.name: True Sight
skills.lite: When an enemy is afflicted by multiple debuffs from Indris and his allies, the enemy's weakness is exposed. Indris' normal attack fires 3 arrows and deals extra true damage to enemies with exposed weakness.
skills.full:
Passive. When an enemy is afflicted by at least 3 different stat reduction debuffs from Indris or his allies, the enemy's weakness is exposed. Indris' normal attacks deal ATK 60% + PWR 6% extra true damage to enemies with exposed weakness. This effect can trigger once every 4s per enemy.
In addition, Indris' normal attack fires 3 arrows, each dealing ATK 165% + PWR 20% damage. The arrows prioritize different enemies with exposed weaknesses. If all 3 arrows hit the same target, the second and third arrows deal 25% less damage.

skills.name: Arcane Binding
skills.lite: Indris knocks back nearby enemies, then casts a binding spell that immobilizes the nearest enemy.
skills.full: Indris knocks back all enemies within 2 tiles, pushing them out of the 2-tile area surrounding him. He then casts a binding spell on the nearest enemy, dealing ATK 170% + PWR 20% damage and immobilizing them for 5s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Indris increases his ATK during battle, which increases further if any enemy has an exposed weakness.
skills.full: Indris increases his ATK by 6% during battle, plus an extra 9% if an enemy has exposed weakness.

skills.name: Windpiercer
skills.lite: Each time Indris triggers the exposed weakness damage bonus, he increases his ATK SPD for a period of time.
skills.full: Each time Indris triggers the exposed weakness damage bonus, he increases his ATK SPD by 40 for 6s. Unstackable.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: After hitting an enemy with Arcane Binding, Indris can trigger the exposed weakness damage without cooldown for a while.
skills.full: After hitting an enemy with Arcane Binding, Indris's normal attacks can trigger the exposed weakness damage bonus without cooldown for 5s.

skills.name: Grimoire Pact
skills.lite: Isabella selects the frontmost ally as her companion. When she casts her Ultimate, she grants the companion powerful buffs.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Isabella selects the allied hero as her companion. If the companion is defeated Isabella will select a new one. Whenever the companion receives a stat boosts to ATK, ATK SPD, Haste, Phys DEF, Magic DEF, or Vitality, Isabella gains a permanent stack of spell note corresponding to that stat. Each type of spell note can stack up to 3 times. Note that stat boosts granted by Isabella's spell notes themselves do not trigger additional stacks of spell notes. When Isabella casts her Ultimate, she increases her companion's ATK by 15% + PWR 1.5% for 6s. Additionally, each spell note stack Isabella carries will increase the companion's corresponding stat: ATK, Phys DEF and Magic DEF: +15% per stack. ATK SPD, Haste and Vitality: +15 per stack.

skills.name: Lingering Grace
skills.lite: Isabella heals her companion and deals damage to enemies around them.
skills.full: Isabella targets only her companion with this skill, healing them for ATK 340% + PWR 40% HP and then dealing ATK 150% damage to enemies adjacent to her companion. 100% of the damage dealt is also converted into extra healing for her companion.

skills.name: Hexward
skills.lite: After her companion is affected by control effects, Isabella can make them unaffected. Additionally, when her companion takes damage, Isabella can reduce the attacker's ATK.
skills.full: After her companion is affected by control effects for 5s, Isabella can make them unaffected for 2.5 + PWR 0.25s. This effect can only trigger once every 5s. Additionally, when an enemy hero deals ATK 350% damage to her companion, Isabella reduces that enemy's ATK by ATK 60% + PWR 7% for 5s. This effect can only trigger once every 5s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Assistance.
skills.full: Increases Assistance by 30 during battle.

skills.name: Retributive Echo
skills.lite: When casting her Ultimate, Isabella also debuffs an enemy hero.
skills.full: When Isabella casts her Ultimate, she also debuffs the enemy hero who has dealt the most damage to her companion, temporarily reducing the stats linked to active spell note stacks from Isabella's Ultimate. The debuffs last 8s and are 80% effective as the corresponding buffs from spell note stacks.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Whenever Isabella's companion receives a powerful buff, Isabella gains an extra stack of spell note.
skills.full: Whenever Isabella's companion receives a buff that increases their ATK, Phys DEF, or Magic DEF by at least 15%, or increases their ATK SPD, Haste, or Vitality by at least 15, Isabella gains an extra stack of the corresponding spell note.

skills.name: Dominance Ring
skills.lite: Kordan creates a hunting circle. All units inside take reduced damage and receive less healing from outside sources, while allied units inside gain extra ATK and Life Drain.
skills.full:
When casting this skill, Kordan raises his blade and challenges 1 enemy within 1 tile, immobilizing the target for 5s. At the same time, he summons a hunting circle around him and his target, dealing ATK 180% damage to all enemies within the circle and knocking back other ranged enemies out of the circle.
The hunting circle stays active for 16s. All units within the hunting circle take 60% less damage and healing from any outside source. Meanwhile, allied units within the circle gain 20% + PWR 3% ATK, 40 Life Drain, and deal 20% + PWR 3% more damage.
Kordan can keep only one circle active at a time. This skill starts with 1,000 Energy.

skills.name: Fury Slash
skills.lite: Kordan deals damage to an enemy and converts a portion of the damage dealt into a shield.
skills.full: Kordan charges up briefly before unleashing a sweeping slash, dealing ATK 280% + PWR 40% damage to an enemy. He also gains a shield equal to 100% of the damage dealt, plus an additional ATK 300%. The shield lasts 15s.

skills.name: Sundering Strike
skills.lite: Kordan knocks down an enemy, dealing damage.
skills.full: Kordan leaps high, slamming his blade down on the enemy to deal ATK 350% + PWR 50% damage and knock them down.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases ATK.
skills.full: Increases ATK by 12% during battle.

skills.name: Rage Unleashed
skills.lite: The first time Kordan assists or defeats an enemy within the hunting circle, he permanently enhances other skills.
skills.full:
When Kordan achieves his first of a non-summoned enemy within the hunting circle, or after he has fought inside the circle for 20s, his Fury Slash and Sundering Strike become enhanced.
'''Enhanced Fury Slash:''' Deals extra damage equal to 30% of the target's lost HP, up to ATK 600%.
'''Enhanced Sundering Strike:''' Allows Kordan to also knock his target into the air, increasing the duration of the subsequent knockdown for 2s and dealing ATK 300% extra damage.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Whenever Kordan assists or defeats an enemy inside the hunting circle, he leaps to a new target and moves the circle to his new position.
skills.full: Whenever Kordan an enemy inside the hunting circle, he leaps to a new target and moves the circle to his new position. Repositioning the circle extends its duration by 10s. All allies within the circle also gain 50 Penetration.

skills.name: Euphoric Rush
skills.lite: Mehira deals damage to all enemies in a target area multiple times and charms them.
skills.full: Mehira marks a target area with her kiss, striking all enemies within 2 tiles 6 times, with each strike dealing ATK 50% + PWR 5% damage. After a short delay, she unleashes a powerful blast in the same area, dealing ATK 170% + PWR 25% damage. Enemies hit by the powerful blast become for 3s.

skills.name: Blissful Whip
skills.lite: Mehira lashes her whip at all units, friend or foe, in a frontal arc, causing HP loss. Allies hit gain Haste.
skills.full: Mehira lashes her whip at all units, friend or foe, in a 3-tile frontal arc 5 times. Each hit causes a unit to lose ATK 20% + PWR 3% HP. If an allied unit is hit, they gain 25 Haste for 8s, and their HP loss from this skill is reduced by 90%. Mehira always targets the direction that hits the most enemies.

skills.name: Alluring Mirage
skills.lite: Mehira draws all enemies toward a designated position.
skills.full: Mehira summons an illusion of herself on the tile closest to the enemy lineup, bewitching all enemies and making them rush mindlessly toward the illusion for 2.2 + PWR 0.1s. When a battle starts, she summons such an illusion on a tile across from where she stands.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Life Drain during battle. Each time the total healing Mehira receives reaches a certain amount, increases her ATK.
skills.full: Increases Life Drain by 8. Each time the total healing Mehira receives from any sources reaches 40% of her initial max HP, her ATK increases by 6%, up to 18%.

skills.name: Total Devotion
skills.lite: Mehira summons voidlings that continuously attack enemies. When she's in danger, she sacrifices one to become temporarily untargetable and recover her HP.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Mehira summons 3 voidlings around her. Each voidling attacks an enemy every 1.5s, dealing ATK 40% damage. If Mehira takes a hit that would reduce her HP below 20%, she sacrifices a voidling to block that damage. She then becomes untargetable for 2.5s and instantly recovers 20% of her max HP.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Increases the damage taken by enemies charmed or bewitched by Mehira.
skills.full: Increases the damage taken by enemies with Mehira's Euphoric Rush or bewitched with her Alluring Mirage by 15%. This effect does not stack.

skills.name: Silver-White Wings that Streak Across the Skies
skills.lite: All of Marcille's skills require chanting to cast. When actively used, she continuously summons Sky Fish to attack enemies.
skills.full: Passive. All of Marcille's skills require chanting to cast. Her chanting speed is affected by both Haste and ATK SPD, and she continuously attempts to cast her various skills. Each time Marcille finishes chanting, she permanently increases her Haste by 10 and Energy Recover Rate by 5%, stacking up to 10 times. Active. Marcille immediately spends 200 Energy and continues to chant ata a cost of 80 Energy per second. Summons Sky Fish to dash across the battlefield and deal ATK 500% + PWR 50% damage to enemies in its path. The base chanting frequency for summoning Sky Fish is once every 2s.

skills.name: Explosive Spell
skills.lite: After chanting for a while, Marcille unleashes an Explosive Spell, dealing AOE damage.
skills.full: After chanting for 3s, Marcille unleashes an Explosive Spell in the area with the most enemies, dealing ATK 300% + PWR 40% damage to all enemies within a 1-tile radius.

skills.name: Magical Flash
skills.lite: After chanting for a while, Marcille unleashes a magical flash, healing an ally while damaging and blinding nearby enemies.
skills.full: After chanting for 2s, Marcille generates a magical flash of light around an ally surrounded by enemies, recovering ATK 300% + PWR 30% of the ally's HP, while dealing ATK 240% + PWR 30% damage to all nearby enemies and blinding them for 4 + PWR 0.4s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Marcille increases her Haste during battle. While chanting to cast her Ultimate, she increases her Haste by an additional amount.
skills.full: Marcille increases her Haste by 10 during battle. While chanting to cast her Ultimate, she increases Haste by an additional 6.

skills.name: Ancient Magic
skills.lite: After chanting for a while, Marcille casts ancient magic to revive a fallen allied hero.
skills.full: Marcille generates an ancient magic circle at her feet. After chanting for 3s, Marcille revives an allied hero and recovers ATK 400% HP for them. This skill can only be cast once per battle. During Battle preparation, if there is an ally placed 1 tile in front of Marcille, this skill will target that ally. However, if Laios is on the team, this skill can revive him one additional time (no position requirement and does not consume the skill's use limit), but this can only trigger once per battle. If the chanting is interrupted, this skill cannot be recast for 5s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Marcille recovers additional Energy while buffed by allies.
skills.full: During battle, Marcille recovers 10 additional Energy per second for each ally who is currently providing her with a buff, up to 3 stacks. At 3 stacks, she becomes .

skills.name: Living Armor - Kensuke
skills.lite: Laios summons a Living Armor that can self-regenerate after defeat to assist.
skills.full: Laios summons a slow-moving armor with infinate HP, controlled by Kensuke. This Living Armor starts with 1,000 Energy and deals damage equal to 300% + PWR 30% of Laios' ATK. It loses 25 Energy per second while it exists. Whenever it takes base damage exceeding 250% + PWR 20% of the caster's ATK, it loses an extra 100 Energy. At zero Energy, the armor crumbles on the spot but regains 125 Energy per second until its Energy is full again, and then it returns to combat. When casting this skill again, Laios recovers 1,000 Energy for Kensuke, grants it control immunity and increases its ATK SPD by 120 + PWR 10 over the next 10s.

skills.name: Intimidate
skills.lite: Laios intimidates enemies in a frontal area, confusing them.
skills.full: Laios spreads his limbs to appear larger and lets out an intimidating roar. Enemies within 3 adjacent tiles in front become confused, unable to move or act and suffer a 44% + PWR 5% reduction in both Phys DEF and Magic DEF for 3s. If the targets are monsters, the confusion effect extends for an additional 4 + PWR 1s after the skill ends.

skills.name: Dungeon Gourmet
skills.lite: Laios collects ingredients from defeated monsters to cook meals that grant buffs to allies.
skills.full:
Passive. Whenever an enemy monster is defeated, Laios collects an ingredient from it and instantly recovers 250 Energy and ATK 500% HP.
Laios uses the collected ingredients and cooks on the spot, recovering ATK 500% HP for allies within 2 tiles and increasing their ATK by 20%| + PWR 5% for 8 + PWR 0.5s. When activly used, for each ingredient Laios has collected, the cooked meal randomly grants one of the following extra buffs:
Increases Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 40%, increases Haste by 30, or recovers ATK 100% HP per second. Extra buffs can only be triggered up to 3 times. If Marcille recives the buff, she recovers an extra 300 Energy.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Laios increases his ATK during battle.
skills.full: Laios increases his ATK by 12% during battle.

skills.name: Ingredient Analysis
skills.lite: Laios analyzes monsters when a battle starts, making them drop more ingredients.
skills.full: When a battle starts, if there are monsters among the enemies, Laios takes out his Dungeon Gourmet Guide and starts analyzing those monsters to make them drop more ingredients. Each monster will prematurely drop an extra ingredient the first time it loses 30% of its max HP. Each monster can only drop 1 extra ingredient this way.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Laios permanently increases his max HP after collecting ingredents.
skills.full: Laios permanently increases his max HP by 20% each time he collects a different ingredient using Dungeon Gourmet. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times.

skills.name: Annihilation Directive
skills.lite:
'''Passive.''' Gunnar summons a Doomfield at the location of the ally placed 1 tile behind him, enhancing that ally. Gunnar prioritizes locking onto the enemy targeted by that ally.
'''Active.''' Gunnar deals massive AoE damage, setting the target area on fire for a while.
skills.full:
When a battle starts, if there is an ally placed 1 tile behind Gunnar, he summons a Doomfield at that ally's location, increasing their normal attack range by 3 and ATK by 25% + PWR 2.5% of Gunnar's initial ATK. He and the ally remain until Gunnar is defeated, or until 3s after the ally leaves the Doomfield. During battle, Gunnar locks onto and prioritizes attacking the enemy targeted by the ally standing on his Doomfield.
'''Active.''' Gunnar deals ATK 320% + PWR 30% damage 2 times to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target tile,then launches a Doomsday Meteor that deals ATK 470% + PWR 50% damage to all enemies within range and sets the ground on fire for 15s. Enemies standing in the fire take ATK 80% + PWR 8% damage every second and lose 40 Vitality. When cast automatically, Gunnar prioritizes targeting the enemy area that allows him to hit the most enemies.

skills.name: Bombing Engine
skills.lite: Gunnar fires his cannons multiple times, dealing damage to all enemies in target areas.
skills.full: Gunnar fires his cannons 6 times, each time dealing ATK 65% + PWR 8% damage to all enemies adjacent to his locked-on target. If there is a Doomfield active, the ally within the Doomfield will also launch 6 coordinated attacks, dealing damage to the locked-on target equal to 6% + PWR 0.5% their max HP and stunning them for 0.5s. This damage cannot exceed Gunnar's ATK 100%.

skills.name: Absolute Defense
skills.lite: Gunnar gains a powerful shield while granting a shield to every ally behind him. At the same time, he empowers the ally within his Doomfield.
skills.full:
Gunnar lets out a roar, granting himself a shield that absorbs ATK 450% + PWR 60% damage. He also grants a shield that absorbs ATK 400% + PWR 40% damage for 6s to every ally him.
If there is a Doomfield active, the Doomfield gets strengthened, increasing the ATK SPD of the ally within it by 40 + PWR 4 for 8s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Ranged DEF and Vitality. For each allied hero standing behind this hero, Ranged DEF and Vitality are increased further.
skills.full: Increases Ranged DEF and Vitality by 10. For each allied hero standing this hero, increases Ranged DEF and Vitality by an extra 7.

skills.name: Fire Suppression
skills.lite: Whenever an ally within Gunnar's Doomfield deals a certain amount of damage, he fires an extra missile that deals damage and restores his HP based on the damage dealt.
skills.full: Whenever the ally within Gunnar's Doomfield deals total damage equal to 1400% of Gunnar's initial ATK; Gunnar automatically launches a missile at his locked-on target, dealing ATK 500% damage and recovering HP equal to 100% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: If an area is already set on fire, striking it again with Doomsday Meteor intensifies the fire, preventing affected enemies from healing or gaining shields.
skills.full: If an area set on fire is struck again by Doomsday Meteor, the area becomes permanently scorched. The fire no longer expires, and enemies within the scorched area cannot heal or gain shields.

skills.name: Form Shift
skills.lite: Hepler enters Altered Form, dealing damage to nearby enemies and taunting them. He also gains a set number of Spark stacks. While in Altered Form, his other skills are enhanced, but cost Spark stacks to cast. When Hepler runs out of Spark stacks, he reverts to his True Form, dealing damage to enemies and blinding them.
skills.full: Hepler enters Altered Form, dealing ATK 230% + PWR 35% damage to all enemies within 2 tiles and taunting them for 5s. He also gains 4 Spark stacks. While Hepler in Altered Form, Remedial Class and Extra Credit are enhanced and have shorter cooldowns, but each costs 1 Spark stack to cast. When Hepler runs out of Spark stacks, he reverts to his True Form, dealing ATK 230% + PWR 35% damage to enemies within 2 tiles and blinding them for 5s.

skills.name: Remedial Class
skills.lite: While in True Form, Hepler deals damage to a single enemy and greatly reduces their Haste. While in Altered Form, Hepler deals AoE damage and stuns enemies.
skills.full: While in True Form, Hepler unleashes destructive magic at an enemy, dealing ATK 300% + PWR 30% damage and reducing the target's Haste by 60 for 3 + PWR 0.3s. While in Altered Form, Hepler strikes the target with powerful blows, dealing ATK 360% + PWR 45% damage to the target and enemies within 1 tile around them, and stunning them for 3 + PWR 0.3s.

skills.name: Extra Credit
skills.lite: While in True Form, Hepler continuously heals 1 ally. While in Altered Form, Hepler continuously heals multiple allies and grants them shields.
skills.full: While in True Form, Hepler casts a healing spell on the ally, healing them for ATK 130% + PWR 16% HP per second for 6s. While in Altered Form, Hepler casts a healing spell on the 3 allies and grant them toughened skin, healing them for ATK 130% + PWR 16% HP per second for 6s and granting them a ATK 400% + PWR 64% shield for 15s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Reduces damage taken. While in Altered Form, further reduces the damage taken.
skills.full: Reduces damage taken by 9% during battle. While in Altered Form, further reduces damage taken by 6%.

skills.name: Fur-ious Rescue
skills.lite: Hepler protects 1 allied hero from the first fatal blow they would take, grants them healing and a shield, then briefly transforms them into an animal that runs toward the back of the battlefield.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Hepler protects the adjacent allied hero. The first time that ally would take a , they instead ignore the damage. At the same time, Hepler heals the ally and grants them toughened skin for 5s, and transforms them into a small animal that runs toward the back of the battlefield. While in animal form, the ally becomes for 3s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Whenever Hepler spends Spark stacks, he and the protected ally permanently increase their Phys & Magic DEF and reduce their damage taken.
skills.full: Whenever Hepler spends Spark stacks, he and the protected ally permanently increase their Phys & Magic DEF by 6% and reduce their damage taken by 3%, stacking up to 10 times.

name: Leymar
title: Former Headmaster of the Serene Lyceum

skills.name: Heroic Slash
skills.lite: Himmel slashes forward repeatedly before finishing with a massive sweep.
skills.full: Himmel delivers 9 consecutive slashes on enemies in a designated frontal area (3-tile wide and 3-tile long), each dealing ATK 60% + PWR 6% damage. He then follows up with a massive sweep that deals ATK 220% + PWR 30% damage to all enemies in front of him, plus extra true damage equal to 15% + PWR 2% of the target's max HP. The extra true damage cannot exceed ATK 300% + PWR 30%.

skills.name: Heroic Dash
skills.lite: Himmel dashes at 2 enemies, striking them and knocking them down.
skills.full: Himmel dashes to the 2 enemies with the highest cumulative damage dealt, dealing ATK 340% + PWR 40% damage and knocking each enemy down for 2s. He then returns to his original position. Himmel remains while casting this skill.

skills.name: Hero Party
skills.lite: Passive. When a battle starts, Himmel forms a Hero Party with allies. Active. Himmel deals damage to enemies in front of him.
skills.full:
Passive. When a battle starts, if at least 1 Mage, 1 Tank, and 1 Support ally are within 1 tile of Himmel, he forms a Hero Party with himself and one ally from each class.
Himmel inspires all party members, increasing their basic stats by ATK 12% + PWR 1% and granting them a shared permanent shield equal to 1500% + PWR 100% of Himmel's initial ATK.
Active. Himmel strikes the target 4 times, each dealing ATK 120% + PWR 20% damage, then converts 30% + PWR 2% of the damage dealt into healing for all party members.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Haste during battle.
skills.full: Increases Haste by 12 during battle.

skills.name: Blue-Moon Blessings
skills.lite: When a battle starts, blue-moon weed petals sweep across the battlefield, granting blessings.
skills.full:
When a battle starts, blue-moon weed petals sweep across the battlefield, bestowing blessings on Himmel and his party members:
Tank & Support: Increases their max HP by ATK 150% of Himmel's initial ATK.
Mage & Himmel: Increases their ATK by 8% of Himmel's initial ATK.
If Frieren is part of Himmel's Hero Party, Himmel places a flower wreath on her, permanently increasing both Himmel's and Frieren's Penetration by 30.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Himmel and his party members cause increased HP loss on bosses.
skills.full: Himmel has the same fighting spirit that once drove him to challenge the Demon King. In Boss Fights, Himmel and his party members cause 12% more HP loss on boss targets.

skills.name: Hailing Arrows
skills.lite: Gwyneth rains down arrows, dealing damage to enemies within range.
skills.full:
Passive. After charging up for a longer time, Gwyneth's normal attack fires an arrow that deals ATK 360% damage. Every point of ATK SPD or Haste further increases her normal attack damage by 0.1%.
Active. Gwyneth selects a tile and rains arrows over it and all tiles within 2 tiles. Enemies on each affected tile take ATK 270% + PWR 35% damage and become for 2s. For each wave of arrows, subsequent hits on the same target deal 80% less damage. This skill prioritizes the area with the most enemies.

skills.name: Fulgur Arrow
skills.lite: Gwyneth fires a Fulgur Arrow, dealing splash damage and inflicting control effects on enemies near the target.
skills.full: Passive. Gwyneth's normal attacks follow a 3-attack cycle. Every 3rd attack is imbued with the power of lightning, silencing the target for 1s, dealing ATK 220% + PWR 30% lightning splash damage to all enemies within 2 tiles of the target, and stunning affected enemies for 0.5s.

skills.name: Flare Arrow
skills.lite: Gwyneth fires a Flare Arrow, dealing higher damage to the target and burning them.
skills.full: The 2nd attack in Gwyneth's normal attack cycle is imbued with the power of fire. It deals ATK 490% damage and burns the target, causing them to take ATK 20% + PWR 2% damage every 0.25s for 4s. While burned, the target has their Vitality reduced by 40. This effect cannot stack.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases ATK SPD and gains an additional increase when there are no enemies nearby.
skills.full: Increases ATK SPD by 15 during battle. If there are no enemies within 1 tiles for 3s, she further increases ATK SPD by 9.

skills.name: Fulgur Flare
skills.lite: Gwyneth triggers the Flare Arrow and Fulgur Arrow simultaneously, dealing high damage to the target and applying both arrows' effects at the same time.
skills.full: Gwyneth's normal attack damage is increased by 20%. The 1st attack in her normal attack cycle is imbued with the power of both lightning and fire, and it burns enemies hit by the lightning splash.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Gwyneth reduces her normal attack interval when there are no enemies nearby.
skills.full: If there are no enemies within 1 tiles for 3s, Gwyneth focuses her aim, reducing the interval between her normal attacks by 40%.

skills.name: Gale Barrage
skills.lite: Kazim continuously fires arrows at enemies within the arc-shaped area, dealing damage.
skills.full:
Passive. When an enemy hero is knocked into the air, Kazim manipulates the air currents to keep them airborne for 1s longer, ATK 100% + then fires 2 tracking feathers at the target, dealing PWR 10% damage each.
Active. Kazim fires a powerful volley of arrows at the arc-shaped area with the most enemies, dealing ATK 320% + PWR 140% damage and knocking all prey within range into the air for 0.5s. After that. he keeps firing arrows in succession for 3s, dealing ATK 200% + PWR 20% damage per volley. The number of volleys fired scales with ATK SPD.

skills.name: Soaring Falcon
skills.lite: When a battle starts, Kazim takes to the air and hunts for prey from above.
skills.full: Passive. When a battle starts, Kazim takes to the air and starts Soaring for 10s. While Soaring, Kazim is invincible and cannot be targeted. When an enemy hero is knocked into the air, Kazim dives at them, dealing ATK 440% + PWR 50% damage and marking them as prey. When Kazim stops Soaring, he draws his bow and fires a powerful arrow at each prey in sequence, dealing ATK 400% + PWR 40% damage and stunning them for 3s.

skills.name: Stormy Dominion
skills.lite: Kazim fires a gale-charged arrow, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them into the air.
skills.full:
When a battle starts, Kazim creates a wind field that covers the entire battlefield. Allies inside the wind field gain 30 Haste. Every time Kazim marks an enemy as prey, the wind field grants 10 extra Haste to allies within it, up to 3 stacks. When Kazim stops soaring, he absorbs the power of the wind field, gaining double the Haste bonus for 15s.
Active. Kazim fires a gale-charged arrow toward the area with the most enemies, dealing ATK 340% + PWR 40% damage to enemies in its path and knocking them into the air for 0.5s. Every time Kazim marks an enemy as prey, this arrow's damage and range are permanently increased by 20%, up to 3 stacks.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases ATK SPD during battle.
skills.full: Increases ATK SPD by 21 during battle.

skills.name: Raptor's Vigil
skills.lite: Kazim's normal attacks lock on to all prey.
skills.full: Kazim's normal attacks deal 25% more damage and lock on to all enemies marked as prey.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Kazim manipulates the air currents to knock an enemy into the air. He gains ATK SPD and Energy whenever he marks an enemy as prey.
skills.full: 2s after Kazim starts Soaring, he manipulates air currents to knock the rearmost enemy hero into the air (only targets enemies who have not moved since the battle began, excluding and targets). Whenever Kazim marks an enemy as prey or an enemy hero is defeated, he permanently gains 20 ATK SPD and 200 Energy. The ATK SPD bonus can stack up to 5 times.

skills.name: Malevolent Gaze
skills.lite: Lamentis commands his apostles to control enemies, then deals heavy damage to all enemies.
skills.full: Each of Lamentis' apostles targets an enemy and stuns them for 3.5s, prioritizing different frontmost enemies. Lamentis then deals ATK 600% + PWR 60% damage to all enemies, while the apostles of the stunned enemies by 20% of Lamentis' initial max HP. After casting this skill, Lamentis and his apostles gain 60 ATK SPD for 10s.

skills.name: Starcrusher
skills.lite: Every third normal attack, Lamentis deals heavy extra damage.
skills.full: Every third normal attack, Lamentis throws an enchanted fork, dealing ATK 210% + PWR 30% damage plus extra damage equal to 20% + PWR 2% of the target's max HP. The extra damage cannot exceed ATK 240% + PWR 30%.

skills.name: Astral Fission
skills.lite: Lamentis sacrifices HP to summon apostles to fight alongside him.
skills.full:
Lamentis sacrifices 5% of his max HP to create 2 apostles from nebulae and particles. The apostles last 12s and inherit 45% + PWR 6% of Lamentis' ATK and 80% + PWR 8% of his HP. They can use normal attacks and Starcrusher, and prioritize attacking Lamentis' current target. Up to 6 apostles can exist on the battlefield at the same time.
If an apostle survives until its duration ends, it will merge back into Lamentis, healing him for HP equal to 80% of the actual damage the apostle dealt while it was active.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases ATK SPD during battle.
skills.full: Lamentis and his apostles gain 20 ATK SPD. For each of his apostles present on the battlefield, they gain an extra 3 ATK SPD.

skills.name: Omnisight
skills.lite: The apostles gain basic stat buffs when using normal attacks, and pass those buffs on to Lamentis when they merge back into him.
skills.full: Every time an apostle uses a normal attack, it gains 1 stack of Growth. Each stack of Growth increases basic stats by 4%. When an apostle's power merges back into Lamentis, Lamentis gains that apostle's Growth. Lamentis can have up to 20 stacks of Growth.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Lamentis gains part of the buffs applied to his apostles.
skills.full: When an apostle is affected by stat buffs from allies, Lamentis also receives 10% of those same buffs.

skills.name: Soul Shepherd
skills.lite: Niru stores 1 ally's soul, allowing them to continue fighting on the battlefield in Spirit form after taking a fatal blow.
skills.full: Niru prioritizes the ally and cast a spell to protect them for a , turning them into a Spirit and restoring their HP to 45% of max HP. The Spirit can only deal 45% + PWR 5% of its original damage while losing an increasing amount of HP every second. Once its HP runs out, the Spirit will be defeated.

skills.name: Soul Reaping
skills.lite: Niru deals damage to the weakest enemy. The lower the target's HP, the higher the damage.
skills.full: Niru attacks the enemy, dealing ATK 120% + PWR 20% damage plus damage equal to 0.3 times the target's lost HP. The additional damage cannot exceed ATK 450%.

skills.name: Spirit Devour
skills.lite: Niru drains the life force of all enemies to heal the weakest ally.
skills.full: Niru drains the life force of all enemies, dealin ATK 150% + PWR 15% damage to each enemy, plus 3% of the target's max HP, up to ATK 70%. He then restores an equal amount of HP to the ally.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases HP during battle.
skills.full: Increases HP by 17% during battle.

skills.name: Ethereal Form
skills.lite: Niru casts Ultimate without consuming Energy when a battle starts.
skills.full: Niru casts Ultimate on the nearest ally without consuming Energy when a battle starts, prioritizing the ally behind himself.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Niru's Soul Reaping briefly prevents the enemy from recovering HP.
skills.full: Niru's Soul Reaping prevents the enemy from recovering HP for 8s.

skills.name: Rain of Blades
skills.lite: Summons flying swords to deal damage to the enemy.
skills.full: Salazer summons plenty of Flying Swords to launch 9 strikes to an enemy with the highest HP. Each strike deals ATK 30% damage plus damage equal to 5% + PWR 0.5% of the target's current HP. Additional damage cannot exceed 150% + PWR 10% of Salazer's ATK. Salazer prioritizes the enemy with the most HP.

skills.name: Enraptured Whip
skills.lite: Salazer whips enemies within the radius of an arc, dealing extra damage once if the enemy's HP ratio is low after being hit.
skills.full: Salazer whips enemies within a 2-tile arc, dealing ATK 180% + PWR 15% damage. When the target's HP ratio drops below 70%, Salazer launches one more attack to enemies within a 2-tile arc, dealing ATK 230% + PWR 25% damage.

skills.name: Spirit Shackles
skills.lite: Salazer deals massive damage to an enemy with a low HP ratio, making them unable to move or act.
skills.full: Salazer imprisons an enemy whose HP ratio is less than 70%, dealing ATK 300% damage and making them unable to move or act for 5 + PWR 1.5s. The skill can only be applied to each enemy once.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Reduces damage taken during battle.
skills.full: Reduces damage taken by 12% during battle.

skills.name: Soul Drench
skills.lite: The Enraptured Whip has no cooldown after a battle starts or an enemy is imprisoned. A guaranteed whip attempt will be added.
skills.full: Salazer immerses himself in the power of the Spirits and casts Enraptured Whip 1 times without cooldown when a battle starts or an enemy is imprisoned. An extra whip strike will be attempted.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Salazer heals himself after imprisoning an enemy.
skills.full: Salazer recovers ATK 150% HP for every imprisoned enemy.

skills.name: Shadow Slayer
skills.lite: Silvina deals damage to the enemy with the most Energy, reducing their Energy.
skills.full: Silvina deals ATK 300% + PWR 50% damage to an enemy and reduces their Energy by 200.

skills.name: First Strike
skills.lite: Silvina flashes next to the closest enemy in a symmetrical position and damages them when a battle starts.
skills.full: Silvina marks the closest enemy in a symmetrical position, flashes next to them, and launches an attack when a battle starts, dealing ATK 300% + PWR 25% damage.

skills.name: Blade Vortex
skills.lite: Silvina's normal attacks are replaced by Whirl Attacks for a short time when a battle starts.
skills.full: Silvina's normal attack becomes Whirl Assault for the first 12s of battle. Each Whirl Assault deals ATK 140% + PWR 10% damage. Defeating the marked enemy prolongs the Whirl Assault duration by 6 + PWR 2s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Crit during battle.
skills.full: Increases Crit by 24 during battle.

skills.name: Shield of Light
skills.lite: Gains a shield at the start of a battle.
skills.full: Silvina gains a shield that can block up to ATK 450% damage after casting First Strike.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Silvina reduces the target's Vitality with each Whirl Assault.
skills.full: Silvina also reduces the target's Vitality by 60 for 3s with each Whirl Assault.

skills.name: Special Aroma
skills.lite: Smokey & Meerky create an aroma and provide continuous healing. Actively using the skill levels up the aroma.
skills.full: After the battle starts, Smokey & Meerky immediately create a special aroma within 2 tiles, continuously emitting its effects while channeling. While the aroma is present, Smokey & Meerky recover 50 Energy per second, and all allies inside the area of effect regain ATK 21% per second. Passive: Smokey & Meerky cannot maintain the aroma if they are under Control Effects and cannot recreate it for 4 seconds once it is interrupted. Active: Smokey & Meerky heal all allies within the aroma by ATK 170% + PWR 15%, and the aroma permanently enhances as follows: - Improved Aroma I: Expands the area of effect by 1 tile. - Improved Aroma II: Grants 30 haste to all allies within the aroma.

skills.name: Energizing Formula
skills.lite: Smokey & Meerky increase the ATK of allies within the aroma and recover Energy.
skills.full: Smokey & Meerky increase the ATK of all allies within the aroma by 16% + PWR 1%. Additionally, for each non-summoned ally affected, they recover 5 Energy per second.

skills.name: Quick Recovery
skills.lite: Smokey & Meerky recover HP for allies within the aroma.
skills.full: Smokey & Meerky instantly heal all allies within the aroma by ATK 90% + PWR 10%.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Smokey & Meerky increase their ATK, and the ATK bonus is further increased when there are 3 or more non-summoned allies within the aroma.
skills.full: Smokey & Meerky passively increase their ATK by 6%. If there are at least 3 non-summoned allies inside the aroma, their ATK is further increased by 9%.

skills.name: Withering Potion
skills.lite: Smokey & Meerky gain Improved Aroma III, dealing more damage to enemies.
skills.full: The Special Aroma gains a third upgrade, increasing its area of effect by 1 tile. Additionally, when the skill reaches its third enhancement for the first time, the aroma is empowered for 10 seconds, causing all enemies within range to lose 12% of their max HP per second. However, the HP lost cannot exceed 200% of Smokey & Meerky’s ATK.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Smokey & Meerky use Special Aroma to recover more HP.
skills.full: Whenever Smokey & Meerky use Special Aroma, their healing is increased by ATK 30%.

skills.name: Fiery Dance
skills.lite: Satrana deals continuous damage to enemies and is invincible during the effect.
skills.full: Satrana does the fiery dance, dealing ATK 240% damage to surrounding enemies within 2 tiles. She is during the effect.

skills.name: Vixen Rush
skills.lite: Satrana attacks enemies within the radius of an arc and gains Life Drain.
skills.full: Satrana scratches enemies in a 1-tile arc twice. Each strike deals ATK 110% damage plus 2.5% + PWR 0.5% target's max HP. The additional damage cannot exceed 75% + PWR 10% of Satrana's ATK. The damage dealt by this skill grants Satrana 100 Life Drain.

skills.name: Ignite Passions
skills.lite: Satrana or allies with Sparks ignite enemies, reducing their Vitality and dealing continuous damage to them.
skills.full: Satrana grants Sparks to allies within 2 tiles when a battle starts. When Satrana or allies with Sparks deal damage to an enemy for 3 times, the target is burned, taking damage equal to 0.8% + PWR 0.2% of max HP every 1s and reducing their Vitality by 20. The skill damage cannot exceed 45% + PWR 5% of Satrana's ATK. The effect lasts until the battle ends.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Reduces damage taken during battle.
skills.full: Reduces damage taken by 12% during battle.

skills.name: Radiant Vigor
skills.lite: Satrana ignites enemies, causing her and her allies to take less magic damage.
skills.full: When an enemy hero is ignited, the magic damage taken by Satrana is reduced by 16% until the battle ends. Satrana grants this effect to a nearby ally when one more enemy hero is ignited.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Vixen Rush's cooldown is removed when all enemy heroes have been ignited.
skills.full: Vixen Rush's cooldown is removed when all enemy heroes are ignited or when a total of 5 enemy heroes have been ignited.

skills.name: Corrosive Dart
skills.lite: Odie deals continuous damage to an enemy.
skills.full: Odie fires a Corrosive Dart, dealing ATK 150% + PWR 20% damage and Dart Poison to an enemy. The poisoned target will receive ATK 30% damage every second until defeated. Dart Poison cannot be dispelled.

skills.name: Triple Tap
skills.lite: Odie deals triple-shot normal attacks to an enemy.
skills.full: Odie deals ATK 60% + PWR 5% damage to an enemy 3 times. The attacks from this skill are considered normal attacks.

skills.name: Venom Surge
skills.lite: Odie increases Dart Poison damage over time with each normal attack that hits the poisoned target.
skills.full: Odie prioritizes launching normal attacks at the nearest poisoned target. When the normal attacks hit a poisoned target, the of the target's Dart Poison is permanently increased by ATK 25%, up to 20 + PWR 2 stacks.

skills.name: Heart Crusher
skills.lite: Odie immediately defeats poisoned targets when their HP is too low.
skills.full: Odie immediately defeats poisoned enemies when their HP drops below a threshold equal to 5.2 times the dealt by Dart Poison per second. Each time a poisoned enemy is defeated, the threshold is increased by 0.5 times the dealt by Dart Poison per second, up to 2 times.

skills.name: Shadow Strike
skills.lite: Seth flashes forward an enemy and deals multiple attacks.
skills.full: Seth flashes forward toward an enemy, dealing ATK 100% damage 3 times, then freezes them briefly and jumps to deal ATK 150% + PWR 20% more damage to the target. When a ghost deals damage, Shemira heals herself for 50% + PWR 5% of the damage dealt. When the ghost returns to her, she heals herself again for 50% + PWR 5% of that damage. The percentage of the ghosts' damage drops to 50% once any enemy has been struck 15 times or more by the ghosts. The strike count resets whenever Shemira casts her Ultimate.

skills.name: Sacrificial Orb
skills.lite: Shemira sacrifices her HP to deal damage to enemies in a straight line.
skills.full: Shemira sacrifices 10% of her current HP to summon the Wailing Orb from the spectral rift 4 tiles away, dealing ATK 320% + PWR 40% damage to enemies in its path.

skills.name: Ghastly Tribute
skills.lite: Shemira sacrifices her HP to deal damage. She can also sacrifice ghosts to deal extra AoE damage.
skills.full:
Passive. Whenever allies' HP or shield value loss reaches 50% of Shemira's max HP, she summons 1 ghost to her side. Shemira can summon up to 5 ghosts outside her Ultimate.
Active. Shemira sacrifices 15% of her current HP to deal true damage to a single enemy equal to 24% + PWR 3% of their max HP. This damage cannot exceed ATK 800%. If Shemira has any ghost summoned, she sacrifices one to strike the target and enemies within 1 tile of the target, dealing true damage equal to 20% + PWR 2% of their max HP. The damage each enemy takes cannot exceed ATK 500%.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Shemira's Energy recovery from attacks increases. After summoning 3 ghosts, her Energy recovery from attacks increases even further.
skills.full: Shemira's Energy recovery from attacks increases by 24% during battle. After summoning 3 ghosts, her Energy recovery from attacks increases by an extra 6%.

skills.name: Spectral Barrier
skills.lite: Shemira sacrifices a ghost to gain a shield. When the shield expires, she unleashes the remaining power of the shield to deal damage to all enemies.
skills.full: Whenever Shemira takes a total of 30% of her max HP in damage or reaches the max number of summoned ghosts, she sacrifices 1 ghost to gain a shield that lasts for 5s. The shield can absorb ATK 250% damage. When the shield expires, Shemira unleashes its remaining power again all enemies, dealing damage equal to the shield's remaining value.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Each time a hero is defeated, Shemira summons a ghost.
skills.full: Each time a hero is defeated, Shemira summons 1 ghost.

skills.name: Lightning Fire Dragon's Roar/Fire Dragon King's Roar
skills.lite: In Lightning Fire Dragon Mode, Natsu deals damage to all enemies within a frontal arc and stuns them. In Fire Dragon King Mode, Natsu deals even greater damage to all enemies within a frontal arc.
skills.full: During battle preparation, choose between Lightning Fire Dragon mode and Fire Dragon King Mode for Natsu. Lightning Fire Dragon King Mode focuses on debuffing enemies, while Fire Dragon King Mode delivers higher damage. In Lighting Fire Dragon Mode, Natsu deals ATK 1400% + PWR 160% damage to all enemies within a 3-tile frontal arc and stuns them for 3s. In Fire Dragon King Mode, Natsu deals ATK 2400% + PWR 280% damage to all enemies within a 3-tile frontal arc.

skills.name: Lightning Fire Dragon's Iron Fist/Fire Dragon King's Iron Fist
skills.lite: In Lightning Fire Dragon Mode, Natsu deals damage to the enemy who has dealt the most cumulative damage, while reducing their Haste. In Fire Dragon King Mode, Natsu strikes an adjacent enemy and knocks them down.
skills.full: In Lightning Fire Dragon Mode, deals ATK 500% + PWR 56% damage to the enemy who has deal the most cumulative damage, while reducing their Haste by 80. The Haste reduction effect diminishes over 5s until it expires. In Fire Dragon King Mode, Natsu strikes an adjacent enemy, dealing damage equal to 44% + PWR 5% of the target's max HP and knocking them down for 0.5s. This damage cannot exceed ATK 1000% + PWR 100% of Natsu's ATK.

skills.name: Fiery Ties
skills.lite: After the first defeat of an ally, Natsu increases his ATK and DEF. If the allied Lucy is defeated, Natsu increases his Crit and Crit DMG Boost.
skills.full: This skill triggers only once per battle after the first defeat of an ally. Fueled by rage, Natsu increases his ATK and DEF by 27% + PWR 3% of the defeated ally's corresponding stats. Additionally, if the allied Lucy is defeated, Natsu increases his Crit by 5 and Crit DMG Boost by 5.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: In Lightning Fire Dragon Mode, Natsu increases his Haste. In Fire Dragon King Mode, Natsu increases his ATK.
skills.full: In Lightning Fire Dragon Mode, Natsu increases his Haste by 9. In Fire Dragon King Mode, he increases his ATK by 12%.

skills.name: "Salamander" Natsu
skills.lite: When Natsu deals damage, he reduces the target's max HP.
skills.full: When Natsu deals damage, he reduces the target's max HP by 40% of the actual damage dealt. This effect does not apply to bosses and the max HP reduction per enemy cannot exceed 800% of Natsu's ATK.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: When Natsu causes an enemy to lose HP through any means other than his normal attacks, he deals continuous damage to the enemy.
skills.full: When Natsu causes an enemy to lose HP through any means other than his normal attacks, he burns the enemy for 5s, dealing ATK 80% damage every 0.5s.

skills.lite: Ravion deals damage to an enemy with multiple hits. Each hit also deals extra damage equal to a percentage of the enemy's lost HP.

skills.lite: Ravion assigns Objectives to his allies. When an ally completes their Objective, they recover Energy and gain an ATK boost. This also unlocks Ravion's Mortal Ace attack, which deals damage to an enemy, reduces their ATK and Phys DEF, and knocks them down.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Ravion assigns an Objective to each of the 2 allies. Allies complete their objective by their dealing damage equal to 2000% of Ravion's initial ATK or an enemy. Upon completion, the ally recovers 150 Energy and increases their ATK by 12% + PWR 1.5% of Ravion's initial ATK for 30s. In boss fights, each Objective is set to be completed exactly 20 seconds after an ally receives it. After 2 allies have completed their Objectives, Ravion actives Mortal Ace. Mortal Ace: Ravion teleports behind the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt, reduces their ATK and Phys DEF by 30% for 8s, then strikes them 2 times, each hit dealing ATK 140% + PWR 20% damage, and knocking them down. Using Mortal Ace also resets Phantom Gambit's cooldown, while Ravion remains during the Mortal Ace attack.

skills.name: Phantom Gambit
skills.lite: Ravion teleports 3 times on the battlefield. The first 2 teleports deal damage to nearby enemies, and the third moves him to a spot away from enemies.
skills.full: Ravion teleports 3 times, each time targeting a tile within 3 tiles of his current position. The first 2 teleports target the tile with the most enemies, dealing ATK 120% + PWR 15% damage to all enemies within 1 tiles upon arrival; the third teleport moves Ravion to a tile within rage that is farthest from enemies. Ravion is while casting this skill.

skills.lite: Ravion increases his ATK in battle. He further increases his ATK after his first Mortal Ace attack.

skills.lite: After Ravion uses his first Mortal Ace attack, he permanently boosts ATK and Haste for himself and any allies who have completed their Obectives.
skills.full: After Ravion uses his first Mortal Ace attack, he permanently increases Haste by 25 and ATK by 25% of his initial ATK for himself and any allies who have completed their Objectives.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: When an ally accepts Ravion's Objective, they temporarily increase their ATK and becoming unaffected for a short period.

Pang focuses on his chi before unleashing a powerful burst that deals damage to nearby enemies. He then enters the Unyielding Force stance, which drains Energy while active.

Pang enters a meditative state, focusing his chi before unleashing a powerful burst at the end of the meditation. The burst deals ATK 350% + PWR 50% damage to enemies within 2 tiles. skills.name: Radiant Fist
skills.lite: Pang strikes an enemy on the head to deal heavy damage.
skills.full: Pang strikes an enemy on the head, dealing ATK 300% + PWR 40% damage. If he is in Unyielding Force stance, this strike deals an extra 12% of the enemy's current HP. The extra damage cannot exceed ATK 240%.

skills.name: Zen Ward
skills.lite: Pang gains a shield and remains unaffected while the shield is active. He deals damage to an enemy when the shield expires, breaks, or is reapplied.
skills.full:
Active. Pang channels his chi, gaining a ATK 340% + PWR 40% Chi Barrier for 9s. While the barrier is active, Pang remains .
when the barrier expires, breaks, or is reapplied, it transforms into razor leaves that deal ATK 210% + PWR 30% damage to Pang's current target. Pang is also unaffected while channeling his chi.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases ATK.
skills.full: Pang increases his ATK by 9% during the battle. He further increases his ATK by an extra 6% while in Unyielding Force stance.

skills.name: Spirit Sync
skills.lite: Pang increases the ATK of any unit shielded by his Chi Barrier.
skills.full: Pang increases the ATK of any unit shielded by his Chi Barrier by 15%.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Pang immediately gains a Chi Barrier upon entering the Unyielding Force stance. While in this stance, he gains extra DEF Penetration.
skills.full: Pang immediately gains a Chi Barrier upon entering the Unyielding Force stance. While in this stance, he gains 30 DEF Penetration.

skills.name: Seed Siphon
skills.lite: Saida teleports to an enemy and plants a Drain Seed in them. The Drain Seed periodically deals damage to the host and reduces their Energy.
skills.full:
Active. Saida teleports in front of an enemy, preventing them from moving or acting. She deals ATK 520% + PWR 60% damage and drains 220 + PWR 20 Energy from the enemy. Saida remains while doing this and plants a Drain Seed in the enemy. She prioritizes enemies without a Drain Seed.
This seed drops to the ground if its host is defeated or if Saida uses her Ultimate on its host again. Up to 8 Drain Seeds can exist on the battlefield at the same time. In boss fights, Drain Seeds on the ground will not obstruct unit movement.
Passive. Every 2.5s, Drain Seeds deal ATK 250% damage to its host and reduces their Energy by 120.

skills.name: Crimson Claim
skills.lite: Passive. Saida restores HP when she deals damage. Any excess healing from this effect is converted into a shield. Active. Saida deals damage to an enemy, commanding nearby Drain Seeds to damage the same enemy.
skills.full:
Passive. Saida restores extra HP equal to 100% of the damage dealt by her normal attacks and skills. Any excess healing from this effect is converted into a shield. The shield value cannot exceed ATK 3000% + PWR 300%.
Active. Saida forms a blood spike to pierce an enemy, dealing ATK 420% + PWR 40% damage an their action. If any Drain Seeds are within 1 tile of the enemy, each one also forms blood spikes to strike that enemy, dealing ATK 30% damage.

skills.name: Revenant Sprout
skills.lite: When Saida is defeated, she consume a Drain Seed to revive.
skills.full: When Saida is defeated, she consumes a Drain Seed to revive at the seed's position, restoring + PWR 1% HP. She prioritizes the oldest seed available and restores an extra for each second the consumed seed existed. The extra HP cannot exceed .

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Saida reduces her damage taken during battle. She further reduces her damage taken for each existing Drain Seed.
skills.full: Saida reduces her damage taken by 12% during battle. She further reduces her damage taken by an extra 2% for each existing Drain Seed, up to a maximum of 10%.

skills.name: Deepening Roots
skills.lite: Saida shortens the interval between Drain Seed attack effects each time she uses her Ultimate.
skills.full: Saida reduces the damage dealt by enemies afflicted with a Drain Seed by 35%. Each time she casts her Ultimate, the interval between Drain Seed attack effects is shortened by 0.5s, up to a maximum reduction of 1.5s for the current battle.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: When a battle starts, Saida plants Drain Seeds in nearby allies.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Saida plants Drain Seeds in 2 nearby allied heroes. These seeds do not harm allies but grant them a shield that can absorb ATK 800% damage.

skills.name: Panic Projection
skills.lite: Pandora opens her box and lets disaster loose. Everyone on the battlefield, friend or foe, is affected. She alone is spared.
skills.full:
Pandora's box holds both calamity and hope.
Passive. Pandora herself is protected by hope and is not affected by this skill. Active. Pandora opens the box to unleash calamity, causing all units on the battlefield to flee in toward their own side for 5s and lose ATK 50% + PWR 5% HP per 0.5s in the process. When the effect wears off, their ATK is reduced by 10% for 8s. This attack reduction effect can stack up to 3 times.

skills.name: Boxed Blessing
skills.lite: When a battle starts, Pandora pulls an ally into her box and restores their Energy.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Pandora pulls the into her box, making them but unable to cast skills. After 4s, the ally is released from the box. If Pandora is alive when that happens, the ally gains 1000 Energy, as well as 35% + PWR 5% ATK for the next 10s.

skills.name: Tainted Tribute
skills.lite: Pandora is corrupted by her box, allowing her to inflict debuffs on enemies based on her current Corruption stacks.
skills.full:
Passive. Each time Pandora casts her skills, she restores ATK 290% + PWR 25% HP and 90 + PWR 10 Energy to the ally she released from her box. At the same time, the box applies Corruption, a permanent debuff that increases damage taken by 10%, to both Pandora and one random enemy not yet affected by Corruption. Pandora's Corruption can stack up to 4 times, while the enemy's Corruption does not stack.
Active. Pandora inflicts a random number of unique debuffs on an enemy over the next 10s, prioritizing enemies not already affected by this skill. The number of unique debuffs is equal to Pandora's current Corruption stacks. These debuffs may include: reducing Haste by 45, reducing Energy recovery by 45%, reducing Vitality by 45, or causing the affected unit's normal attacks to have a 45% chance to miss. These effects do not stack.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: During battle, Pandora's max HP increases, and by an extra amount after being corrupted by her box.
skills.full: During battle, Pandora's max HP increases by 12%, and by an additional 6% after being corrupted by her box.

skills.name: Eternal Legacy
skills.lite: Pandora's box remains on the battlefield after she is defeated and cannot be destroyed.
skills.full: After Pandora is defeated, the box stays on the battlefield. It's indestructible, unaffected, and won't be prioritized as a target. It has an Energy cap of 1,000 ad recovers 45 Energy per second. At full Energy the box unleashes Panic Projection again, but without the HP loss effect. Every 5s, it also casts Tainted Tribute on a random enemy but inflicts only one random debuff.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Allies placed inside the box are immune to Pandora's Ultimate.
skills.full: The ally pulled into Pandora's box is permanently protected by hope, making them immune to Panic Projection. This effect remains even after Pandora is defeated.

skills.name: Divine Rend
skills.lite: Perseus marches continuously in one direction while swinging his spear.
skills.full: Perseus chooses a direction and marches 3 tiles forward with dazzling spearwork. Along the way, he deals ATK 85% + PWR 10% damage to adjacent enemies 11 times and continuously knocks them back in the direction of his march. At the end of the march, Perseus performs a mighty shield bash, dealing ATK 280% + PWR 30% damage to all enemies within 1 tiles and stunning them for 2s. Perseus stays while casting this skill.

skills.name: Spear-Shield Combo
skills.lite: Perseus swings his spear and shield, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
skills.full: Perseus swings both his spear and shield in a circle to strike nearby enemies. With his spear, he deals ATK 200% + PWR 20% damage to adjacent enemies. With his shield, he deals ATK 140% + PWR 10% damage to adjacent enemies while gaining a shield value equal to ATK 360% of his ATK plus 80% of the damage dealt for 6s. While the shield lasts, his ATK SPD increases by 35.

skills.name: Fertile Ground
skills.lite: Perseus grants buffs to allies standing on fertile ground.
skills.full: Before Perseus takes heavy damage, the ground within 1 tile around him turns fertile. Allies standing on this fertile ground have their ATK increased by 14.5% + PWR 1.5% and Phys & Magic DEF increased by 19% + PWR 2.5%. When Perseus' HP drops below 40% of his initial HP for the first time, he draws power from the fertile ground, increasing his max HP permanently by 60% + PWR 6% and healing for the same amount. Once this power is drawn the fertile ground withers away permanently.

skills.lite: Increases his ATK in battle. Further increases his ATK after receiving temporary stat buffs.
skills.full: Increases his ATK by 9% in battle. Further increases his ATK by 6% when he has temporary stat buffs from allies.

skills.lite: Perseus gains stronger effects from any temporary stat buffs he receives.
skills.full: Perseus is blessed by Bountiful Grace. When he gains a temporary stat buffs, its effect is increased by 20%. Each temporary stat buff from a different ally also increases his damage dealt by 15% and reduces his damage taken by 15%. This effect stacks up 4 times.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Expands the range of fertile ground.
skills.full: Expands the range of fertile ground by 1 tiles.

skills.name: Rend Rupture
skills.lite: Nazrik marks an enemy as his Prey. When casting this skill, he throws a spear to trigger all Rend stacks on an enemy.
skills.full: 4s into battle, Nazrik marks the enemy who has taken the most damage as his Prey and prioritizes them as the target for all his skills. When casting this skill, Nazrik silently prays before hurling a spear with a guaranteed critical hit, dealing ATK 600% + PWR 70% true damage to an enemy. After a short delay, he triggers all Rend stacks on that enemy, dealing ATK 35% + PWR 3.5% extra damage per stack.

skills.name: Savage Wound
skills.lite: When Nazrik lands a critical hit with a spear throw, he inflicts Rend on the enemy hit. Enemies with Rend take damage whenever they cast their ultimate.
skills.full: Whenever Nazrik lands a critical hit on an enemy with a spear throw from his normal attacks or skills, he deals extra damage equal to 6.5% + PWR 0.8% of the enemy's initial max HP. The extra damage cannot exceed ATK 180% + PWR 20%. Each hit also reduces the enemy's max HP by the same amount, up to 40%. Against bosses, the max HP reduction does not apply; instead, the extra damage is converted into true damage. Additionally, each hit inflicts 5 stacks of Rend on the enemy, up to 30 stacks. This effect cannot be dispelled. When an enemy affected by Rend casts their Ultimate, they take ATK 35% + PWR 3.5% damage for each Rend stack they currently have.

skills.name: Staggering Strike
skills.lite: Nazrik hurls a spear at the enemy with the highest total healing done, dealing damage, stunning them, and reducing their Healing.
skills.full: Nazrik hurls a spear at the enemy with the highest total healing done, dealing ATK 300% + PWR 40% damage, stunning them for 3s, and reducing their healing by 90 for 15s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Nazrik increases his Crit and gains extra Crit after inflicting a certain number of Rend stacks.
skills.full: Nazrik increases his Crit by 24 during battle. After inflicting a total of 15 Rend stacks on enemies, he gains an extra 12 Crit.
