skills.lite: Allied units have a chance to inflict Rend stacks whenever they deal damage to Nazrik's Prey.
skills.full: Nazrik reduces his Prey's Crit Resist by 16. When allied units land a critical hit on his Prey, they inflict 1 stack of Rend. Each ally can apply only 1 Rend stack per second this way.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Each time Nazrik lands a critical hit, that hit gains increased Crit DMG Boost.
skills.full: Each time Nazrik lands a critical hit on an enemy, the Crit DMG Boost of that hit increases by 0.8 for every 1% of Nazrik's crit rate.

skills.lite: Solise sends a Bulb to each non-summoned ally. When certain conditions are met, the Bulb will bloom into a Bulbsprite. In either form, it continuously heals its host and grants buffs.

When a battle starts, Solise sends a Bulb to each non-summoned ally, blessing them with nature's gift. These Bulbs provide ATK 40% + PWR 10% healing to their host every 3s. Solise becomes while casting this skill.
During battle, each Bulb can store any excess healing its host receives. When this stores healing reaches 600% of Solise's initial ATK, the Bulb blooms into a Bulbsprite. skills.lite: Solise heals the weakest allies. If a healed ally has a Bulbsprite with them, they also gain a shield.

skills.lite: When a Bulbsprite deals damage, it deals extra damage equal to a portion of the total excess healing it has stored.

skills.lite: Silven summons flying blades to attack enemies.

skills.name: Gravity Collapse
skills.lite: Silven knocks the enemy down with the force of gravity and detonates the Blademarks on them.
skills.full:
When a flying blade sent by Silven's normal attacks hits an enemy, it leaves a Blademark. If Aloft Edge is active, increases the range of Gravity Collapse by 1 tile, and launches extra flying blades, dealing ATK 48% + PWR 6% damage 6 times.

skills.name: Tempered Field
skills.lite: Silven sets up a field to enhance his flying blades.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Silven sets up a Tempered Field around himself, increasing his Ranged DEF by 48 while the field is active. Silven's flying blades sharpen when passing through the field, dealing extra true damage equal to 1.3% + PWR 0.2% of the target's max HP, up to ATK 14% + PWR 2%. The field disappears if Silven moves, and will reappear after he stands still for 3s.

skills.full: Increases ATK SPD by 21 during battle.

skills.name: Oath of Fealty
skills.lite: When Silven receives a temporary stat buff from an ally, he gains Energy, Penetration and ATK SPD.
skills.full: When Silven receives a temporary stat buff from an ally, he immediately recovers 300 Energy and permanently gains 4 Penetration. He also permanently increases the ATK SPD of both himself and that ally by 16. This effect can only by triggered once per ally.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Silven deals more damage to enemies with a high HP ratio.
skills.full: When up against powerful foes, Silven's knightly spirit kick in, allowing him to deal 25% more damage to enemies whose current HP ratio is higher than 50%.

skills.name: Wild Shift
skills.lite: Pippa immobilizes and teleports enemies.
skills.full:
Pippa immobilizes 2 enemies, then teleports them onto a target tile and drops them, dealing ATK 200% + PWR 50% damage to the enemy on that tile and knocking them down. When auto-cast is on, Pippa prioritizes targeting the tile of the frontmost enemy.
Passive. Whenever Pippa casts a skill, the skill has a 20% chance to go out of control. When this happens, the skill target is teleported to a random location on the enemy side of the battlefield, sometimes ending up in very unexpected places! Pippa remains while casting the skill.

skills.name: Mad Missiles
skills.lite: Pippa fires magic missiles in quick succession.
skills.full:
Pippa fires 9 magic missiles at enemies in quick succession, each missile dealing ATK 60% + PWR 6% damage.
If the skill goes out of control, the missiles strike random targets on the battlefield, including allies!

skills.name: Botanical Woe
skills.lite: Pippa summons magical plants to deal damage and drain Energy.
skills.full:
Pippa summons magical plants in the area with the most enemies. The plants cover a 1-tile area and persist for 3s. Every second, the plants deal ATK 140% + PWR 20% damage to enemies within and reduce their Energy by 150.
If this skill goes out of control, the plants last only ls, drifting like a moonflower.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Haste. After casting multiple skills without going out of control, Haste is further increased.
skills.full: Increases Haste by 10 during battle. After casting 4 skills without going out of control, Haste is further increased by 5.

skills.name: Mage's Bloom
skills.lite: When Pippa casts a skill, it has a chance to trigger mutation.
skills.full: Pippa's skills will not go out of control the first time they are cast, and every skill cast has a 30% chance to trigger mutation. After mutation triggers, whenever Wild Shift, Mad Missiles, or Botanical Woe deals damage, Pippa deals extra true damage equal to 80% of the original damage to enemies adjacent to the target and them for 2s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Pippa sends the teleported targets falling through portals.
skills.full: When Pippa's Wild Shift triggers a mutation, the enemy on the target tile becomes immobilized. The 2 teleported enemies continue falling through portals for 1.5s before landing on the target tile, taking extra damage equal to 20% of their max HP. This extra damage cannot exceed 400% of Pippa's ATK.

skills.name: Princess Rally
skills.lite: Peggy summons royal guards and has them take damage for allies.
skills.full:
Passive. When a battle starts, Peggy summons 2 royal guards to join the fray. The royal guards inherit 120% + PWR 16% of Peggy's HP and 50% + PWR 7% of her ATK. If Peggy is defeated, all royal guards immediately leave the battlefield.
Active. Peggy blows her horn, instantly healing all remaining royal guards for an amount equal to their max HP. If there are fewer than 2 guards remaining, she summons a new royal guard to the battlefield. Peggy then orders these royal guards to protect all allies for 12s. During this time, 70% of the damage taken by all allies is shared evenly among the guards, while the guards' own HP loss is reduced by 75%.

skills.name: Royal Scroll
skills.lite: Peggy restores HP to royal guards and allies.
skills.full: Peggy opens a magic scroll, healing all remaining royal guards and 2 other allies for Peggy's ATK 150% + PWR 18% HP per second for 8s.

skills.name: Royal Barrage
skills.lite: Peggy summons a royal marksman to fire armor-piercing arrows, increasing the ranged damage taken by the affected enemies.
skills.full: Peggy summons a royal marksman in the backline to assist in battle. The marksman inherits of Peggy's ATK and fires 3 volleys of armor-piercing arrows, dealing ATK 200% + PWR 20% damage to 2 enemies. Enemies hit by the armor-piercing arrows take 22% + PWR 3% more for the next 5s. During this time, allied summons' against the affected enemies is increased by an extra 14% + PWR 2%.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Haste during battle.
skills.full: Increases Haste by 10. If 2 royal guards are on the battlefield, further increases Haste by 5.

skills.name: Royal Protection
skills.lite: Royal guards are enhanced while Princess' Rally is active.
skills.full: The royal guards can alternate between normal attacks and royal sword moves while Princess' Rally is active, dealing ATK 200% damage to all enemies within 1 tiles and gaining a permanent shield equal to 80% of the actual damage dealt.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Peggy increases all allied summons' ATK and Phys & Magic DEF when multiple allied summons are on the battlefield.
skills.full: When 3 or more allied summons from different allies are alive at the same time, all allied summons gain ATK equal to 30% of Peggy's initial ATK, and Phys & Magic DEF equal to 40% of Peggy's initial Phys & Magic DEF.

skills.name: Drowning Doom
skills.lite: Enemies affected by control effects can be afflicted with Nerion's drowning effect and take increased damage. After Nerion casts his Ultimate, his ATK and ATK SPD increase, and his normal attacks can bounce between drowning enemies.
skills.full:
Passive. When an enemy has been under control effects for 6s, they take ATK 350% + PWR 35% damage and are afflicted with drowning. Nerion deals ATK 30% more damage to drowning enemies. And both effects last until the end of the battle.
This passive effect takes only 4s to trigger on enemies that deal magic damage.
Active. Nerion empowers himself with the force of the tide for 12s. While this effect lasts, his ATK and ATK SPD are increased by 22% and 60+ PWR 8 respectively, and his normal attacks gain the Deluge effect: when a normal attack hits, it bounces between drowning enemies, dealing ATK 220% + PWR 30% extra damage. Each unit can be hit by the bounce up to 1 time.

skills.name: Tidal Rebuke
skills.lite: After every few normal attacks, Nerion's next normal attack is enhanced. Upon hitting a target, the enhanced normal attack knocks the target back, deals extra damage, and stuns them.
skills.full: After every 3 normal attacks, Nerion's next normal attack becomes enhanced. Upon hitting a target, the enhanced normal attack knocks the target back 1 tile, deals ATK 270% + PWR 30% damage, and stuns them for 2s.

skills.name: Riptide Wrath
skills.lite: Nerion deals damage to enemies within an area, then after a short delay, knocks enemies in the area into the air and deals damage again.
skills.full: Nerion throws his spear at the area with the most enemies. Upon hitting the target tile, the spear deals ATK 140% + PWR 20% damage to all enemies within 1 tile. 2s later, a raging current erupts, knocking all enemies within the same area into the air and dealing ATK 210% + PWR 30% damage.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases ATK SPD during battle.
skills.full: Increases ATK SPD by 21 during battle.

skills.name: Abyssal Embrace
skills.lite: When a battle starts, Nerion applies the drowning effect to the rearmost enemy. Drowning enemies have their ATK and Haste reduced and take continuous damage while under control effects.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Nerion applies the drowning effect to the enemy. Drowning enemies have their ATK and Haste reduced by 20% and 40 respectively, and take ATK 50% damage every time they have been under control effects for 0.5s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: When all non-summoned enemies are under the drowning effect, Nerion becomes permanently empowered by the force of the tide and increases his Penetration.
skills.full: When all non-summoned enemies on the battlefield are under the drowning effect, or if a total of 4 non-summoned enemies have been affected by it, Nerion immediately gains 1000 Energy and becomes permanently empowered by the force of the tide. While permanently empowered, Nerion gains 30 extra Penetration if he has more than 800 Energy.

skills.name: Grand Finale
skills.lite: Sylphira lights up her score during battle to increase her ATK and Haste. When the skill is used actively, she creates a Harmonic Domain that silences enemies inside, then attacks the target multiple times.
skills.full:
Passive. Sylphira lights up 1 beats on her score every 1s. 1 extra beats light up whenever an enemy is affected by an or defeated; each ally can trigger this once per second per enemy. Once 12 beats are lit, Sylphira activates her score, increasing her ATK by 50% + PWR 5% and Haste by 30 + PWR 3. In addition, the musical effect of the skill triggers Resonance, spreading the skill's effect to up to 2 enemies within 2 tiles of the target.
Active. Sylphira glides into the 2-tile area with the most enemies, dealing ATK 400% + PWR 40% damage to enemies within range and creating a 2-tile Harmonic Domain that lasts for 10 + PWR 1s. Enemies within the domain are while Sylphira becomes as long as she remains inside. After that, she performs 5 musical phrases, dealing ATK 110% + PWR 20% damage to her target and reducing their max HP by the same amount.

skills.name: Punishing Rhythm
skills.lite: Sylphira strikes the target with 3 hits, dealing damage and reducing their Energy.
skills.full: Sylphira uses her tuning fork to perform Legato, striking the target with 3 rhythmic hits. Each hit deals ATK 150% + PWR 20% damage to the target and reduces their Energy by 120.

skills.name: Piercing Silence
skills.lite: Sylphira drives her tuning fork into the target, triggering a resonant blast that knocks down nearby enemies.
skills.full: Sylphira drives her tuning fork into the enemy, briefly controlling them and dealing ATK 200% + PWR 20% damage. She then charges it with melody to trigger Staccato, dealing ATK 320% + PWR 40% damage to the target and all nearby enemies within 1 tile while knocking them down for 2s. Sylphira is immune to control effects while casting this skill.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Haste during battle.
skills.full: Increases Haste by 6 during battle. Every time she lights up a beat, she increases her Haste by 1. Once her score is activated, she further increases her Haste by 6.

skills.name: Harmonic Refrain
skills.lite: Once her score is activated, Sylphira plays it to dispel her debuffs and recover HP and Energy.
skills.full: Once her score is activated, Sylphira starts playing it. The score then plays 1 times automatically every 8s. Every time the score plays, it removes all dispellable debuffs from Sylphira and restores 40% of her max HP and 250 Energy. While the score is active, collecting more beats makes it play 10% faster and further increases Sylphira's Haste by 3, up to 10 stacks.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Once her score is activated, Sylphira's normal attacks deal extra true damage and gain Life Drain.
skills.full: Once her score is activated, Sylphira performs Tremolo to enhance her normal attacks. The enhanced normal attacks gain 50 Life Drain and deal extra true damage equal to 18% of the target's max HP. The extra true damage dealt cannot exceed ATK 600%.

skills.name: Fatal Waltz
skills.lite: Orion summons a magical rapier at a designated location, dealing damage multiple times and stunning enemies.
skills.full: Orion summons a magical rapier at a designated location. For the next 1.5s, it rapidly slashes all enemies within 1 tile, dealing ATK 60% + PWR 10% damage 8 times. After that, the rapier erupts in a burst of magic, dealing ATK 420% + PWR 40% damage once more and stunning enemies within range for 3 + PWR 0.3s.

skills.name: Fervent Flurry
skills.lite: When a battle starts, Orion enchants his rapier. When this skill is used actively, he deals damage multiple times to the target.
skills.full:
Passive. When a battle starts, Orion enchants his rapier for 15 + PWR 2s. While the enchantment is active, he gains Energy 25% faster, and each instance of damage from his skills or normal attacks applies a stacking Sear effect to enemies for 3s. Each stack of Sear deals damage every second equal to 20% + PWR 2% of the base damage from the instance that applied it.
Active. Orion thrusts at the target 4 times in quick succession, dealing ATK 90% + PWR 10% damage with each thrust.

skills.name: Velvet Glove
skills.lite: Orion recruits Supporters during battle to empower himself. When this skill is used actively, he strikes enemies in a frontal arc with magical slashes and gains a shield.
skills.full:
Passive. Whenever an ally grants Orion a temporary stat buff, the enchantment on his rapier is extended by 10s, and that ally becomes his Supporter.
Active. Orion unleashes a magical slash in a 1-tile frontal arc, dealing ATK 340% + PWR 40% damage and gaining a shield equal to 200% of the damage dealt for 6s. All his Supporters gain 60% of the shield Orion gains.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases ATK, with an extra ATK increase when Supporters are present.
skills.full: Orion increases his ATK by 9% during battle. If he has Supporters on the battlefield, his ATK increases by an extra 6%.

skills.name: Royal Prerogative
skills.lite: Orion gains Authority from his Supporters. Each stack of Authority increases Orion's damage dealt and reduces his damage taken.
skills.full: Every time Orion gains a Supporter, he receives 1 stack of Authority, up to 3 stacks. Each stack of Authority increases Orion's damage dealt by 14%, reduces his damage taken by 18%, and extends the duration of Sear effects he inflicts by 1s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: After gaining a certain number of Authority stacks, Orion becomes unaffected, and the Sear effect he inflicts deals extra true damage.
skills.full: After gaining a total of 3 Authority stacks, Orion becomes for the rest of the battle, and the Sear effect he inflicts deals extra true damage equal to 50% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Soul Retaliation
skills.lite: Thoran charges up to slash at enemies in range, dealing damage plus a percentage of damage received during the charge, and gains Life Drain.
skills.full: Thoran charges up for a moment to slash at enemies within range, dealing ATK 200% + PWR 20% damage plus ATK 180% of the damage received during the charge. He also gains 20% Life Drain. Thoran is while casting this skill.

skills.name: Soul Plunder
skills.lite: Thoran drains a portion of the HP from the enemy with the highest HP to increase his own HP.
skills.full: Thoran targets the non-soul-plundered enemy with the highest HP and drains 18% + PWR 1.5% of the target's current HP to increase his max HP by the same amount. He also causes this target to receive 13% more damage for the rest of the battle. Drained HP limit: ATK 600% of Thoran's ATK.

skills.name: Resurrection
skills.lite: Thoran will resurrect with a portion of his HP restored after a short time when defeated; this effect can be triggered once per battle.
skills.full: Thoran will resurrect with + PWR 4% HP restored after a short time when defeated. This effect can be triggered once per battle.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Thoran's normal attacks and skills increase his Energy Recovery; this increase is higher when Resurrection is not triggered.
skills.full: Thoran's normal attacks and skills increase his Energy Recovery by 24%. His Energy Recovery is increased by an extra 6% when Resurrection is not triggered.

skills.name: Soul Pact
skills.lite: Before a battle starts, Thoran signs a pact with the ally on the tile behind him, agreeing to take a portion of damage for this ally until the battle ends. When Thoran is defeated, this ally sacrifices a portion of their current HP to save and heal Thoran.
skills.full: Before a battle starts, Thoran signs a pact with the ally on the tile behind him, agreeing to take 50% of the damage for this ally until the battle ends. When Thoran is defeated, this ally sacrifices 85% of their current HP to save and heal Thoran by 150% of this portion of HP. After that, Thoran no longer takes damage for this ally.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Thoran drains HP from the enemy again when casting Soul Retaliation.
skills.full: Thoran drains another 20% of the current HP from all enemies affected by Soul Plunder when casting Soul Retaliation, increasing his max HP by the same amount.

skills.name: Spiritual Viper
skills.lite: Viperian burns HP and sends Darkvipers to possess the enemies, dealing massive damage.
skills.full: Passive. Viperian burns HP as much as possible when a battle starts, sending Darkvipers to possess all enemies until his HP is below 60%. During this skill, he is while losing 7% max HP for each Darkviper deployed. Every possessed enemy drops 20 Energy on Hit, losing HP per second to sustain the survivability of the Darkviper on them. Viperian calls a Darkviper back to recover HP when is HP ratio is below 30%. Active. Viperian deals ATK 280% + PWR 20% damage to all possessed enemies. He inflicts the nearest enemy with the same effect and Darkviper possession if no enemy on the battlefield is possessed.

skills.name: Soul Ravager
skills.lite: Viperian drains HP from the healthiest enemy.
skills.full: Viperian drains HP from the enemy, dealing ATK 210% + PWR 25% damage and recovering HP that equals the damage dealt.

skills.name: Enchantment Fang
skills.lite: Darkvipers launch Tearing Bite periodically to deal damage.
skills.full: Passive: Darkvipers launch Tearing Bite once every 3s during the battle, dealing ATK 65% damage once to all the possessed enemies. Active: Viperian burns 10% max HP to enhance the next Tearing Bite, dealing ATK 140% damage to the target and reducing thier Energy by 60 + PWR 15.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Haste during battle.
skills.full: Increases Haste by 12 during battle.

skills.name: Crimson Waltz
skills.lite: Burns HP to deal massive damage to all enemies when having a higher HP portion.
skills.full: Viperian burns HP 19s into a battle if his HP ratio is above 90%, dealing ATK 420% damage to all enemies. He is during the skill casting. This skill can be triggered once every 30s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Darkvipers return when the possessed enemies are defeated, recovering HP and Energy for Viperian.
skills.full: Darkvipers return when the possessed enemies are defeated, recovering HP and 80 Energy for Viperian.

skills.name: Knight's Heart
skills.lite:
'''Passive.''' Tamesia charges on the battlefield, dealing damage to all enemies on her path.
'''Active.''' Tamesia summons her mount on leap forward, dealing damage and knocking back adjacent enemies down, and increasing her charge speed.
skills.full:
'''Passive.''' Temesia does not perform normal attacks. Instead, she selects the farthest enemy and charges toward them dealing ATK 125% damage + PWR 10% damage to all enemies in her path. Upon reaching the target, she changes direction and restores 180 Energy. Temesia's attack animation speed is not affected by her ATK SPD or Haste. Each point of ATK SPD or Haste increases her charge damage by 1%.
'''Active.''' Temesia summons her mount Dawn to leap forward, dealing ATK 300% damage to adjacent enemies and knocking them down. Her charge speed will be increased by ATK 10% afterward, up to 2 stacks.

skills.name: Iron Heel
skills.lite: Tamesia deals damage and reduces damage dealt by the enemy when charging in the opposite direction
skills.full: Temesia commands her mount Down to kick an enemy while changing the charge direction, dealing ATK 150% + PWR 15% damage and inflicting an interruption effect. Reduces the enemy's damage dealt by ATK 15% for 5s.

skills.name: Courage Sword
skills.lite: Tamesia deals damage to the surrounding enemies based on the targets ATK
skills.full: Temesia wields her broadsword to attack adjacent enemies four times while charging, dealing damage that is equal to ATK 40% + PWR 5% of the targets' ATK. Each damage doesn't exceed ATK 70% + PWR 7% of her ATK.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Tamesisa's ATK increases during battle. She gains extra ATK after the first Knight's cast.
skills.full: Temesia increases her ATK by ATK 11% during battle. She also gains an extra 2% ATK the first time she casts Knight's Heart.

skills.name: Invincible Fury
skills.lite: Tamesia gains permanent control immunity and turns the charge damage into true damage after casting Ultimate several times.
skills.full: Temesia permanently becomes Unaffected after casting Knight's Heart 2 times, turning the charge damage into true damage.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Tamesia reduces the enemys phys DEF if they are hit by the Knight's Heart.
skills.full: Reduces the enemy's Phys DEF by 1% when hit by Knight's Heart, up to 6 stacks.

skills.name: Swift Shift
skills.lite: Vala switches to Skyblaster Mode to deal damage and stun the enemy, or to Sword Mode to inflict massive true damage on her target.
skills.full:
When Vala casts the skill at an empty tile, she jumps to the tile and switches to Skyblaster Mode. She prioritizes shooting the marked enemy, dealing ATK 450% + PWR 40% damage and stunning them for 4s.
When Vala casts the skill at an enemy, she switches to Sword Mode. She rushes to slash the target, dealing ATK 420% + PWR 25% true damage. And all her normal attacks become melee attacks.
In Auto Battle, Vala switches to Sword Mode and prioritizes the marked enemy if their HP ratio is lower than 50%. Otherwise, she switches to Skyblaster Mode to shoot the enemy and remains at a safe distance.

skills.name: Notice Beforehand
skills.lite: Vala sends a notice to mark an enemy. She prioritizes attacking the marked enemy and absorbs their Energy.
skills.full: Vala sends a notice to mark the farthest enemy when a battle starts. She prioritizes attacking the noticed enemy, absorbing 90 + PWR 10 Energy for each hit. When the noticed enemy is defeated, Vala sends a new notice to mark the farthest enemy if she is in Skyblaster Mode or to the nearest if she is in Sword Mode.

skills.name: Checkmate
skills.lite: Vala deals damage to an enemy and reduces their Haste, or hits an enemy 3 times.
skills.full:
In Skyblaster Mode, Vala shoots with an exclusive anesthetic bullet, dealing ATK 230% + PWR 20% damage to an enemy and reducing their Haste by 60 for 8s.
In Sword Mode, Vala hits the enemy 3 times, dealing ATK 100% + PWR 8% damage each hit and stunning them for 1s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Vala increases her ATK during battle. She gains extra ATK every time a non-summoned enemy is defeated.
skills.full: Vala increases her ATK by 9% during battle. She also gains an extra 3% ATK every time a non-summoned enemy is defeated.

skills.name: Night Maneuver
skills.lite: Vala increases her movement speed and Haste when the marked enemy is defeated.
skills.full: Vala blends into the darkness when the marked enemy is defeated, making her untargetable until all other allies are defeated. During this time, her movement speed increases by 60% and Haste by 80 for 10s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Vala deals a higher damage to the marked enemy.
skills.full: Vala increases her damage dealt to the marked enemy by 10%.

skills.name: Thunder Swordwork
skills.lite: Valen launches several strikes within range and gains Invigoration.
skills.full: Valen selects a tile and launches 7 Swift Strikes at the selected tile and its adjacent tiles. Each strike deals ATK 70% + PWR 10% damage to all targets. Valen is while striking. After striking, Valen gains Invigoration for 12s, increasing his ATK by 20%.

skills.name: Unseen Blade
skills.lite: Valen strikes the enemy 3 times and deals chain damage to other enemies during Invigoration.
skills.full: Valen strikes the target 3 times. Each strike deals ATK 100% + PWR 10% damage. During Invigoration, Valen generates forked lightning with each strike, dealing equal damage to the target and up to 2 nearby enemies within 2 tiles.

skills.name: Fury Thunder Strike
skills.lite: Valen casts lightning strike only when he gains Invigoration, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
skills.full: Valen casts his lightning strike only when he gains Invigoration, dealing ATK 190% + PWR 20% damage to all enemies within 2 tiles.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases ATK.
skills.full: Increases ATK by 12% during battle.

skills.name: Eternal Thunder
skills.lite: Valen gains permanent Invigoration and increasing ATK bonus.
skills.full: Valen gains permanent Invigoration. When casting Thunder Swordwork during Invigoration, he permanently gains 10% ATK bonus, up to 10 stacks.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Valen stuns the enemy with Fury Thunder Strike.
skills.full: Valen inflicts a 3s stun with his Fury Thunder Strike.

skills.name: Six-Shot
skills.lite: Walker fires at enemies in front one by one after loading bullets, dealing damage and stunning them.
skills.full: Walker loads his revolver with 6 bullets, randomly shooting at enemies in front, prioritizing enemies not hit during this cast. Each bullet deals ATK 50% damage plus 5% + PWR 1% of the target's max HP (the bonus damage is up to ATK 60%), stunning the target for 1.5 + PWR 0.2s. Subsequent hits on the same target deal 50% damage.

skills.name: Shotgun Blast
skills.lite: Walker's normal attacks are enhanced to cause AoE damage.
skills.full:
Walker shoots 3 penetrative bullets using normal attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the frontal area. His main target will always receive damage from 3 bullets, each with ATK 34% + PWR 6% damage.
Walker's normal attack range cannot be buffed any further.

skills.name: Bounty Pursuit
skills.lite: Walker prioritizes attacking the enemy with the highest accumulated damage dealt, during which he gains a buff.
skills.full: Walker claims the bounty on the enemy with the highest accumulated damage dealt 10s after a battle starts. Walker prioritizes attacking this enemy upon claiming the bounty, increasing his damage dealt by 25% + PWR 5% and reducing his damage taken by 18% + PWR 5%. Walker gains 5 + PWR 3 Crit Boost (up to 15 + PWR 9) till the battle ends when the targeted enemy is defeated.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases Crit DMG Boost during battle.
skills.full: Increases Crit DMG Boost by 30 during battle.

skills.name: Aerial Thunder
skills.lite: Walker throws grenades at the beginning of a battle, dealing AoE damage and stunning his enemies.
skills.full: Walker throws a grenade at each of the 3 enemies when a battle starts, then uses his revolver to detonate the grenade. The enemies within a 1-tile arc will be stunned for 2s, taking ATK 140% damage and losing 10% Phys DEF in 15s upon grenades exploding. The above skill effect only takes effect once when multiple grenades hit the same target.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Walker gains a shield when dealing damage to the bounty target for the first time.
skills.full: Walker gains a shield equal to 20% of max HP when dealing damage to the targeted enemy for the first time. This shield lasts till the target is defeated.

skills.name: Ancient Tenacity
skills.lite: Ulmus returns to his initial tile and takes root when his HP is low. When he casts this skill, he knocks the target and adjacent enemies into the air.
skills.full:
'''Passive.''' When Ulmus' HP ratio drops below 30% for the first time, he retreats to the backline and takes root to recover + PWR 2% HP. When rooted, Ulmus is and unable to move. His normal attacks become ranged and deal an additional 50% damage to enemies surrounding the primary target.
'''Active.''' Ulmus attacks an enemy, knocking the target and adjacent enemies into the air, dealing ATK 200% + PWR 20% damage plus an extra damage. This skill prioritizes the area with the most enemies within his attack range.

skills.name: Verdant Barrier
skills.lite: Ulmus gains a shield that deals damage to surrounding enemies when it breaks. He grants the shield to the frontmost ally instead after taking root.
skills.full: Ulmus gains a + PWR 3% shield that lasts 10s. When the shield breaks, it deals ATK 160% + PWR 15% damage to surrounding enemies. If Ulmus is rooted, he will grant the shield to the ally instead.

skills.name: Way of the Forest
skills.lite: Ulmus continues to recover HP, or Energy if he takes root.
skills.full: '''Passive.''' Ulmus recovers 3.5% + PWR 0.5% of his lost HP per second. When rooted, he will instead recover 30 + PWR 4 Energy per second.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases max HP during battle.
skills.full: Increases max HP by 17% during battle.

skills.name: Prowling Roots
skills.lite: Ulmus deals damage to an enemy whenever they are knocked down and increases the duration of the knockdown.
skills.full: Ulmus extends his roots to trap vulnerable enemies on the battlefield. Whenever an enemy target is knocked down, knocked into the air or affected by other displacement effects, Ulmus binds the target to the ground, increasing the knockdown duration by 2 and dealing ATK 80% damage. This effect can only affect the same enemy once every 10s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Ulmus knocks back adjacent enemies when the shield granted by Verdant Barrier breaks.
skills.full: Ulmus knocks back adjacent enemies by 1 tile when the shield granted by Verdant Barrier breaks or vanishes.

skills.name: Divine Conflagration
skills.lite: Talene consumes her HP to shoot flames at enemies.
skills.full:
Talene flies to a designated tile in the center of the battlefield, consumes 12.5% of her max HP and 250 Energy per second to shoot a 5-tile flame, dealing 150% + PWR 20% damage and extra damage equal to 170% + PWR 5% of her lost HP to enemies within range. The extra damage is shared among all hit enemies.
Talene can cast this skill even when she is out of Energy, but the HP consumed per second will increase to 20% This skill ends when there are no more enemies within range.

skills.name: Radiant Resurgence
skills.lite:
Passive Talene restores HP for allies when she loses HP and deals damage to enemies when she is healed.
Active. Talene summons Divine Fire to deal damage to enemies.
skills.full:
Passive. Whenever Talene loses 10% of her max HP, she will release a warm current that restores ATK 40% HP for the allied hero. Whenever she restores 10% of her max HP, she will unleash a torrent that deals ATK 50% damage to the enemy.
Active. Talene consumes 20% of her max HP to summon Divine Fire in the area with the most enemies, dealing ATK 200% + PWR 10% damage that comes with an extra 40 + PWR 3 Life Drain to adjacent enemies.

skills.name: Blazing Ascension
skills.lite: Talene transforms into a ball of flame whenever she is defeated, during which her HP will restore over time. She can resurrect when her HP reaches a certain value.
skills.full: Talene transforms into a ball of flame whenever she is defeated. During this state, she cannot be attacked as she is not considered alive, and she can restore 8% of her max HP per second as well as benefit from allies' skills When her HP reaches above 65%, she will resurrect and bring about an explosion, dealing ATK 150% + PWR 10% damage to enemies within 2 tiles and knocking them 1 tile back. After each resurrection, her Vitality during the flame state will be reduced permanently by 33.

skills.name: Pyre of Renewal
skills.lite: Talene enhances the frontmost allied hero, allowing them to deal continuous damage to adjacent enemies.
skills.full: Talene grants Pyre of Renewal to the allied hero other than herself from the beginning of the battle until the end. Pyre of Renewal carrier will deal damage equal to 50% of their ATK per second to adjacent enemies and restore HP equal to 25% of their damage dealt. Every time the carrier is healed by an amount equal to 500% of their ATK, a kindling will be generated next to them to permanently enhance Talene's Pyre of Renewal, increasing its damage dealt by 50% for up to 3 stacks.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Talene increases her HP recovery rate when defeated for the first time.
skills.full: Talene increases her HP recovered per second to 15% while in the flame state when defeated for the first time in a battle.

skills.name: Eternal Dreamscape
skills.lite: Tasi summons a dream to hypnotize all enemies, causing them to take damage each second.
skills.full: Tasi summons a dream that lasts for 3.5 + PWR 0.5s, hypnotizing all enemies. Hypnotized enemies cannot move or act and take ATK 70% + PWR 12% damage per second.

skills.name: Dream Dance
skills.lite: Tasi consumes HP to deal damage and stun nearby enemies, then flies to a distant enemy to deal damage and stun again.
skills.full: Tasi consumes 10% of her current HP to deal damage equal to 110% + PWR 10% of her consumed HP to adjacent enemies, stunning them for 0.5s. The damage dealt will be no less than ATK 60%. She then flies to the farthest enemy and applies the same effect to adjacent enemies. However, the second hit on the same enemy will deal only 50% of the original damage.

skills.name: Fluttering Dream
skills.lite: Tasi transforms into a butterfly when she loses a certain amount of HP. In this form, she recovers HP while dealing damage to nearby enemies.
skills.full: Tasi enters her dream realm and transforms into a butterfly upon losing HP. In this form, she becomes , recovering ATK 120% + PWR 10% HP per second while dealing ATK 45% + PWR 5% damage to adjacent enemies. This effect lasts for 3s, and Tasi can cast this skill up to 2 times in one battle.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Tasi increases her ATK and gains an additional increase while Eternal Dreamscape is active.
skills.full: Tasi increases her ATK by 9% during battle. After casting Eternal Dreamscape, she gains an extra 6% ATK while the dream lasts.

skills.name: Shimmering Dust
skills.lite: Tasi gains Haste and reduces damage taken after casting Eternal Dreamscape. Additionally, she can cast Dream Dance more quickly.
skills.full: Tasi gains 70 Haste and reduces damage taken by 90% for 5s after casting Eternal Dreamscape. During this time, Dream Dance no longer costs Tasi's HP to cast and has no cooldown. Its damage counts as if Tasi had consumed 10% of her current HP, and she will prioritize targeting the farthest hypnotized enemy.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Tasi gains an extra attempt to cast Fluttering Dream each time she assists or defeats an enemy.
skills.full: Tasi gains an extra attempt to cast Fluttering Dream each time she a non-summoned enemy.

skills.name: Phantom Slasher
skills.lite: Passive: Valka's normal attacks apply Panic stacks to her target, striking them with a fear of battle. Active: Valka unleashes powerfull slashes on an enemy in the panic state, dealing damage and healing herself.
skills.full: Passive. Valka applies a stack of panic to an enemy with her normal attacks, lasting 10s. After 4 stacks, the enemy is struck with a sudden fear of battle, falling into a panic state for 10ss and losing 10 Haste. Valka can only cast Blooming Terror on adjacent enemies who are in a panic state. This skill consumes 100 Energy and removes the enemy's panic status, stunning them while executing two powerful slashes. Each slash deals true damage equal to 6% + PWR 1.5% of the target's max HP and recovers ATK 350% + PWR 50% of Valka's HP. Afterward, Valka draws her sword to land another slash, dealing true damage equal to 12% + PWR 2% of the target's max HP and knocking them down. Each slash damage is capped at ATK 400%. While casting, Valka is and can only use this skill on the enemy once every 6 + PWR 0.4s.

skills.name: Deathbloom Scheme
skills.lite: Valka skillfully utilizes various sword techniques in battle.
skills.full: Valka refines her combat skills and masters new sword techniques as she levels up. Each sword technique is considered a normal attack with its own cooldown. Masters "Soul Slicer": When there is more than one adjacent enemy, Valka consumes 300 Energy to deliver 2 slashes, each dealing ATK 140% + PWR 20% damage.

skills.name: Spectral Bulwark
skills.lite: When a battle starts, Valka gains a shield and increases her allies' ATK SPD.
skills.full: When a battle starts, Valka gains a shield that blocks damage for each ally within 1 tile, up to a maximum of . In addition, Valka increases the ATK SPD of these allies by 50 + PWR 5 until the battle ends.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases ATK SPD during battle.
skills.full: Increases ATK SPD by 18 during battle.

skills.name: Soulshock Riposte
skills.lite: Valka blocks the enemy's Ultimate and launches a counterattack.
skills.full: Upon taking Ultimate skill damage from an enemy within her attack range, Valka instantly blocks the attack and becomes immune to the damage. She then casts Blooming Terror on the attacker without consuming Energy or removing the enemy's panic status. Instead, she recovers 250 Energy. While casting, Valka is and can only use this skill on the same enemy once every 10s.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: While shield granted by Spectral Bulwark is active, Valka recovers Energy from launching normal attacks.
skills.full: While shield granted by Spectral Bulwark is active, Valka recovers 50 extra Energy from launching normal attacks.

skills.name: Ruthless Rite
skills.lite: Velara summons magic circles that can be awakened to affect nearby allies and enemies. Once all magic circles are awakened, their effects extend across the entire battlefield.
skills.full:
Passive. When a battle starts, Velara summons 4 dormant magic circles on the battlefield. Each circle awakens after accumulating 1000 Energy. When a circle awakens, it affects all units within 2 tiles, restoring ATK 40% + PWR 8% HP to allies and reducing enemies' Haste by 30 + PWR 5.
Active. Velara channels her Energy into one of her dormant circles until it awakens. If all circles are already awakened, she instead expands their area of effect to cover the entire battlefield and transfers 30% + PWR 3% of from all enemies, then evenly distributing them among all allied units, lasting for 10s. The transferred stats that each ally receives cannot exceed 45% of Velara's starting stats. In boss fights, allies will always receive the maximum amount of transferred stats.

skills.name: Sinbound Shackles
skills.lite: Velara immobilizes the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt and reduces their stats.
skills.full: Velara the enemy with the highest cumulative damage dealt, reducing their Haste by 50 + PWR 10 and their Phys & Magic DEF by 45% + PWR 6% for 5s. Each awakened magic circle extends this duration by 0.5s.

skills.name: Merciful Harvest
skills.lite: Velara awakens a magic circle when a battle starts. Magic circles gain Energy from nearby enemies affected by stat reduction debuffs.
skills.full:
If Velara is placed within a magic circle when a battle starts, that circle is immediately awakened. Otherwise, the circle farthest from her position is awakened instead.
Passive. Every 3s, each magic circle gains Energy based on the stat reduction debuffs on enemies within 2 tiles. For each unique ally who inflicted any of those debuffs, the circle gains 24 + PWR 4 Energy.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Velara increases her Haste, with an extra boost when all magic circles are awakened.
skills.full: Velara increases her Haste by 12 during battle. When all her magic circles are awakened, her Haste is increased by an extra 3.

skills.name: Graceful Edict
skills.lite: Awakened magic circles periodically apply effects to the weakest units.
skills.full:
When a magic circle awakens, it fires a mystic bolt to the unit within 2 tiles. If the unit is an ally, they gain a ATK 500% shield for 8s; if it's an enemy, they take ATK 300% damage.
Each awakened magic circle increases value applied or damage dealt by this skill by 10%.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: After all magic circles are awakened, Ruthless Rite causes them to cover the entire battlefield until the battle ends. Each subsequent cast makes allies unaffected and increases their damage.
skills.full: After all magic circles are awakened, casting Ruthless Rite expands their area of effect to cover the entire battlefield until the battle ends. Each subsequent cast makes allied units and increases their damage dealt by 5% for 5s.

skills.name: Moonveil Manifest
skills.lite: Thador deals AoE damage and performs the Moonveil Rite, inflicting debuffs on affected enemies.
skills.full: Thador slams the ground with his shield, dealing ATK 320% + PWR 30% damage to enemies within 2 tiles and conjuring a ritual zone for the Moonveil Rite. The ritual zone lasts for 12s and reduces the Crit DMG DEF of enemies within by 40. When enemies have accumulated damage totaling 1500% of Thador's initial ATK while inside the zone, he unleashes a shadow eruption dealing 160% of damage to each enemy inside the zone. Each ally is then healed for 80% of the eruption's total damage dealt. The eruption can trigger once per Moonveil Rite.

skills.name: Darkmoon Pact
skills.lite: Thador designates an ally as his lieutenant, increasing their Crit. When casting this skill, Thador grants a shield to both himself and his lieutenant.
skills.full:
Passive. During battle preparation, Thador designates the ally placed 1 tile behind him as his lieutenant. While Thador remains alive, his lieutenant gains 15 + PWR 1.5 Crit.
Active. Thador grants both himself and his lieutenant a shield that absorbs ATK 350% + PWR 35% damage for 8s.

skills.name: Crescent Cleave
skills.lite: Thador swings his blade, dealing damage to enemies in front of him and knocking them down.
skills.full: Thador swings his curved blade in a 2-tile crescent arc, dealing ATK 310% + PWR 30% damage to enemies in front of him and knocking them down for 1.5s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Reduces damage taken during battle.
skills.full: Reduces damage taken by 12% during battle.

skills.name: Umbral Descent
skills.lite: When Thador's lieutenant casts Ultimate for the first time, Thador deals damage to all enemies and reduces their Phys & Magic DEF.
skills.full: When Thador's lieutenant casts Ultimate for the first time, Thador summons the Darkmoon over the battlefield. While active, the Darkmoon deals ATK 80% damage to each enemy every 0.5s and reduces their Phys & Magic DEF by 55%. After 6s, the Darkmoon fades, dealing ATK 520% damage to each enemy. This effect can trigger once per battle.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Thador continuously restores his own HP while his lieutenant is alive.
skills.full: Thador restores 5% of his max HP every second as long as his lieutenant is alive.

skills.name: Savage Slash
skills.lite: Zandrok raises his axe and slams it down, destroying all obstacles within the area.
skills.full: Zandrok raises his axe and slams down on the enemy, destroying all obstacles within 2 tiles of their position. The impact deals + PWR 2% damage to enemies in the area nd knocks them in the air for 1s.

skills.name: Rallying Roar
skills.lite: Zandrok summons illusions to destroy all obstacles in their path.
skills.full:
Passive. When a battle starts, Zadrok summons illusions of himself that charge forward in a 5-tile-wide wedge formation toward the enemy side, dealing damage and destroying all obstacles in their path. Any allies they pass through, including Zandrok, become inspired. Inspired Zandrok and allies gain 50% + PWR 5% and 20% + PWR 2% extra max HP respectively until the battle ends, with their current HP remaining unchanged. They also increase their Life Drain by 40 + PWR 4, Haste by 20, and movement speed by 100% for 8s.
Active. Zandrok inspires his allies within 2 tiles, increasing their Life Drain by 25 + PWR 4 and Haste by 14 for 8s. Unstackable.

skills.name: Shock Stomp
skills.lite: Zandrok stomps the ground, striking nearby enemies.
skills.full: Zandrok stomps the ground, dealing damag eequal to 12% + PWR 1.5% of his max HP to enemies within 1 tile and stunning them for 1.5s.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Zandrok increases his max HP during battle. He further increases his max HP while temporary Rallying Roar buffs are active.
skills.full: Zandrok increases his max HP by 12% during battle. He further increases his max HP by an extra 6% while the temporary buffs granted by Rallying Roar are active.

skills.name: Hunter's Fury
skills.lite: Zandrok deals extra damage equal to a portion of his max HP with his normal attacks.
skills.full: While Zandrok's HP is higher than 50% of his initial max HP, his normal attacks deal extra damage equal to 4% of his max HP.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Any excess healing Zandrok receives is converted into max HP.
skills.full: Any excess healing Zandrok receives is converted into max HP. The total max HP gained from this effect cannot exceed 50% of his initial max HP.

skills.name: Vein Pulse
skills.lite: Zanie reduces her max HP and deploys 2 laser turrets. When actively used, Zanie increases ATK and ATK SPD for herself and her laser turrets, while boosting laser turrets' damage dealt.
skills.full:
Passive. Zanie has her max HP reduced by 15%. When a battle starts, she deploys 2 laser turrets, that inherit 140% of her max HP and 80% of her ATK. These turrets are immobile and . Each turret fires lasers at random enemies within 5 tiles, dealing damage equal to 100% of the laser turret's ATK. If the 2 turrets start the battle within 2 tiles of each other, they become linked, combining their energy to fire at the nearest enemy, dealing damage equal to 55% of the laser turrets' total ATK every 0.5s. This combined attack also reduces the target's shield value by up to 30% of the laser turrets' total ATK.
Active. Zanie increases ATK SPD by 15 + PWR 4 and ATK by 20% + PWR 2% for herself and her laser turrets for 10s. During this time, laser turret attacks deal extra damage equal to 3% of the target's current HP, up to 60% of the laser turret's ATK.

skills.name: Iron Defense
skills.lite: When a battle starts, Zanie builds a gun turret that prioritizes attacking the enemy closest to any laser turret.
skills.full: Passive. When a battle starts, Zanie builds a gun turret in front of her. The turret inherits 70% of her max HP and ATK. Its normal attack has a range of 3 tiles and deals damage equal to 100% + PWR 10% of the gun turret's ATK, prioritizing the enemy closest to any laser turret. After 2 normal attacks, the gun turret charges up its next attack into a devastating heavy barrage that fires 6 consecutive rounds at the enemy. Each round deals damage equal to 50% of the gun turret's ATK, stuns the enemy for 0.5s, and knocks them back.

skills.name: Field Repairs
skills.lite: Zanie can repair one of her turrets during battle, restoring its HP and granting it a shield.
skills.full:
Passive. When her gun turret is destroyed, Zanie moves to its remains to fully repair it and grant it a shield that can block ATK 500% damage. She then returns to her original position. This effect can only be triggered once per battle.
Active. Zaniemoves to the to repair it, restoring ATK 300% + PWR 45% HP and granting it a shield that blocks ATK 500% + PWR 50% damage. Zanie then returns to her original position.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increases the hero's Penetration during battle.
skills.full: Increases Penetration by 12 during battle.

skills.name: Precision Overload
skills.lite: Upgrades a turret to make it more powerful.
skills.full: Every 22s, Zanie upgrades one of her turrets, increasing its max HP and ATK by 40% and expanding its range by 1 tiles. She will prioritize upgrading the frontmost laser turret. Each turret can only be upgraded once per battle.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Laser turret attacks burn enemies hit.
skills.full: When a laser turret hits an enemy, it burns them, reducing their ATK by 20% and dealing damage equal to 100% of the turret's ATK per second for 5s. The burn effect cannot stack. If the turret is linked to the other laser turret, the burn effect also reduces the enemy's Phys DEF by 30%.

skills.name: Wrath of the Wilds
skills.lite:
'''Passive.''' Tilaya gains Vine Wrd, a shield that gradually recovers its value over time.
'''Active.''' Tilaya swings her greatsword repeatedly, dealing damage to enemies in front.
skills.full:
'''Passive.''' When a battle starts, Tilaya loses 70% HP and gains Vine Ward, a shield that blocks up to + PWR 12% damage. Vine War automatically recovers + PWR 1% shield value every second and makes Tilaya while active. When Vine Ward breaks, it enter a 3s cooldown, after which its shield value is restored to .
'''Active.''' Tilaya swings her greatsword 8 times, hitting enemies within a 2-tile arc in front. Each swing deals ATK 60% damage tiwce. While casting this skill, Tilaya reduces her damage taken 70%; every time she takes 4 hits, she performs an additional swing, up to 12 swings total. If no enemies are within range, Tilaya charges toward the nearest enemy and continues casting this skill. Tilaya's Haste stat does not affect this skill when used actively.

skills.name: Mighty Slash
skills.lite: Tilaya launches a powerful strike on her target and restores shield value to Vine Ward.
skills.full: Tilaya charges briefly and launches a powerful strike on her target, dealing ATK 220% damage. If Vine Ward is active, she restores its shield value by 160% + PWR 15% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Wildwood Resonance
skills.lite: Tilaya's greatsword resonates with nearby plants, causing her attacks to deal extra damage based on her current shield value for a certain duration.
skills.full:
Tilaya's greatsword resonates with nearby plants, causing her attacks to deal extra damage equal to 6% + PWR 1% of her curent shield value for 10s. This extra damage cannot exceed ATK 200%.
When Tilaya casts this skill, the duration of the resonance is extended by 3.5s for each ally within 2 tiles.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increase Vitality during battle.
skills.full: Increase Vitality by 11 during battle.

skills.name: Verdant Growth
skills.lite: After the first Vine Ward break, the shield value recovered after cooldown increases.
skills.full: The first time Vine Ward breaks, it instantly recover shield value without triggering its cooldown. For subsequent Vine Ward breaks, the shield value recovered after cooldown is increased to .

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: Increases Vine Ward's shield recovery speed while Tilaya casts her Ultimate.
skills.full: Increases Vine Ward's shield value recover to per second while Tilaya casts her Ultimate.

skills.name: Guardian's Ring
skills.lite: Zorya alternates between dormant and awake states. Every time she awakens, she jumps to near enemies and deals damage.
skills.full:
'''Passive.''' Zorya's skill are powerful and have short cooldowns, but she can only use them while awake.
When a battle starts, Zorya enter a dormant state. While dormant, she remains and recovers 85 Energy and 7% max HP per second. Once her Energy is full, Zorya awakens and join the fight.
Every time Zorya awakens, she jumps to the area with the most enemies, dealing ATK 300% + PWR 4% damage to enemies within 2 tiles and stunning them for 2s. While awake, she is and consumes 70 Energy per second. When her Energy is fully depleted, she returns to her dormant state.
Zorya's Energy cannot be modified by sources other than this skill. Instead, for every 10 Energy she would have gained, her ATK permanently increases by 1%, stacking up to 100 times.

skills.name: Gargoyle Rampart
skills.lite:
When Zorya awakens, she reduces her damage taken.
'''Active.''' Zorya deals damage to enemies in front and knocks them down.
skills.full:
'''Passive.''' When Zorya awakens, her skin hardens like stone, reducing her damage taken by 70%. This effect gradually fades over 10s.
'''Active.''' Zorya summons arcane wings that sweep forward in a 2-tile arc, dealing ATK 270% + PWR 30% damage to enemies hit and knocking them down for 2s.

skills.name: Devouring Strike
skills.lite: When Zorya awakens, she increases her Life Drain. When this skill is used actively, she deals damage to nearby enemies multiple times.
skills.full:
'''Passive.''' While awake, Zorya gains bloodlust, increasing her Life Drain by 20. Whenever an enemy hero is defeated within 2 tiles, she immediately heals herself for 30% of her max HP.
'''Active.''' Zorya deals ATK 85% + PWR 10% damage to all enemies within 2 tiles twice. Then, she launches an intimidating strike on the targets within range, dealing ATK 250% + PWR 30% damage, plus extra damage equal to 15% of their lost HP. The extra damage cannot exceed ATK 150%.

skills.name: Hero Focus
skills.lite: Increase damage dealt, with an extra damage increase when there are 2 or more enemies nearby.
skills.full: Increases damage dealt by 9% during battle. If there are 2 or more enemies within 2 tiles, increases damage dealt by an extra 3%.

skills.name: Intimidating Field
skills.lite: While awake, Zorya creates a forcefield that reduces affected enemies' movement speed and Haste, while greatly boosting her own Haste.
skills.full: While Zorya is awake, she creates a 2-tile forcefield around herself, causing all enemies within it to lose 80% movement speed and 60 Haste, while increasing her own Haste by 20. Whenever an allied hero casts their Ultimate, the Haste bonus from the forcefield permanently increases by 15, stacking up to 4 times.

skills.name: Enhance Force
skills.lite: When Zorya takes a fatal blow, she avoids defeat and immediately enters the dormán state.
skills.full: When Zorya would take a , she channels all her Energy to survive and immediately enters her dormant state. This effect can trigger once per battle.
